title: CLIMATE POLICY, AIR POLLUTION IMPACTS, AND THE DISTRIBUTION OF INCOME
abstract:
This paper examines how policies intended to reduce carbon dioxide (CO
2
) emissions affect air pollution exposure, mortality risk, and monetary benefits across the income distribution in the United States (U.S.). We use an energy system optimization model (ESOM) to translate several climate change mitigation policies into CO
2
-equivalent emission reductions. The ESOM also tracks emissions of three air pollutants: fine particulate matter, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen oxides. The AP3 model links changes in emissions of local air pollutants to county-level ambient concentrations, exposure, mortality risk, and monetary damages. We present three central results. First, the monetary benefits from reduced air pollution exposure of the climate policies amount to less than 1% of real per capita income. Second, the monetary benefits are progressively distributed. Specifically, counties with a 10% higher real median income level tend to incur between 5% and 6% lower benefits from the carbon tax, the net zero scenario, and the clean electricity standard in 2030. These estimated elasticities are closer to zero in 2040 and 2050. Third, benefits are distributed progressively in the northeast and the western census regions, and regressively in the Midwest. In the southeast, benefits and income are uncorrelated.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了旨在减少二氧化碳（CO2）排放的政策，如何影响美国不同收入群体的空气污染暴露、死亡风险和货币化收益。我们使用能源系统优化模型（ESOM）将若干气候变化减缓政策转化为CO2当量减排量。ESOM还追踪三种空气污染物的排放：细颗粒物、二氧化硫和氮氧化物。AP3模型将地方空气污染物排放的变化与县级环境浓度、暴露、死亡风险和货币化损害联系起来。我们提出三项核心结果。第一，气候政策带来的空气污染暴露减少所产生的货币化收益，不超过实际人均收入的1%。第二，货币化收益呈累进分布。具体而言，实际收入中位数高10%的县，在2030年碳税、净零情景以及清洁电力标准下，所获收益往往低5%至6%。这些估计的弹性在2040年和2050年更接近于零。第三，在东北部和西部人口普查区，收益呈累进分布；而在中西部则呈累退分布。在东南部，收益与收入不相关。

title: Intended and Unintended Consequences of Facility-Level Mandatory CSR Disclosure: Evidence from the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program
venue: Journal of Accounting, Auditing and Finance
abstract:
We study the real effects of the first nationwide mandatory CSR disclosure regulation in the U.S., the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP). Starting in 2010, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) requires the disclosure of greenhouse gas emissions by facilities emitting more than 25,000 metric tons of
CO
2
per year. We construct a novel set of emission data on power plants around the regulation to examine the causal effects of GHGRP in the utility industry. Using a difference-in-difference research design, we find that while as intended by the policy power plants that are subject to the GHGRP reduced carbon dioxide emission rates by 7%, the reduction in emission no longer holds at the firm level. Specifically, we detect evidence of strategic behavior by firms that own both GHGRP plants and non-GHGRP plants. Presumably unintended by the policy, such firms strategically reallocate emissions between plants to reduce GHGRP-disclosed emissions. This evidence suggests that the reporting program is costly to the affected firms which reacted both positively towards the policy objectives and also somewhat negatively at the same time, not as intended by the policymakers. We also provide evidence of a stronger reduction in plant emissions by publicly traded firms, which is consistent with prior literature supporting shareholder pressure as a primary channel through which mandatory Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) reporting programs affect firm behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国首个全国性强制企业社会责任（CSR）披露法规——温室气体报告计划（GHGRP）的实际效果。自2010年起，美国环境保护署（EPA）要求每年排放超过2.5万公吨CO2的设施披露温室气体排放。我们围绕该法规构建了一套关于发电厂排放的新数据，以考察GHGRP对公用事业行业的因果效应。利用双重差分研究设计，我们发现，与政策设计的初衷相符，受GHGRP约束的发电厂将二氧化碳排放强度降低了7%，但这一减排在企业层面并不成立。具体而言，我们发现了同时拥有GHGRP电厂和非GHGRP电厂的企业存在战略性行为的证据。这些企业很可能并非政策制定者的本意，而是在电厂之间战略性地重新分配排放，以减少GHGRP披露的排放量。这一证据表明，该报告计划对受影响企业而言成本高昂，这些企业一方面对政策目标作出了积极反应，但同时也做出了一定程度的消极反应，而这并非政策制定者的预期。我们还发现，上市公司的电厂排放减少幅度更大，这与既有文献一致，即股东压力是强制性CSR报告计划影响企业行为的主要渠道。

title: Polluting Public Funds: The Effect of Environmental Regulations on Municipal Bonds
abstract:
We present two findings on how environmental policy uncertainty impacts municipal bond returns. First, yields increase after a new pollution standard is proposed but decrease after this standard is finalized. Second, after annual announcements of compliance status, yields fall for counties that remain in compliance but increase for newly noncompliant counties. We present suggestive evidence linking these short-run municipal bond market reactions to long-run changes in pollution and housing prices. Our findings suggest that increases in either regulatory stringency or uncertainty over future environmental policy increase the cost of municipal debt raised to fund schools, hospitals, and critical infrastructure.
This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance.
Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02340 .

title: An Evaluation of Reduced-Complexity Models of Air Quality Over Historical, Policy-Relevant PM2.5 Concentration Changes
abstract: Chronic exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) has been linked to increased mortality rates. Chemical transport models (CTMs) are often used to evaluate PM2.5 regulations in the United States, but are computationally expensive and require significant technical expertise. Reduced-complexity models (RCMs) for PM2.5 are computationally-efficient air quality models designed to estimate ambient PM2.5 concentrations attributable to emissions of PM2.5 and PM2.5-precursors. We evaluate the ability of three widely-used RCMs (AP3, EASIUR, and InMAP) to reproduce changes in PM2.5 concentrations during 1990-2010. Compared to changes in observed, speciated PM2.5 concentrations, RCMs demonstrated strong correlation (R=0.61–0.66) and low mean error (0.84–1.03 μg m-3), performing comparably to a CTM (R=0.72, error=0.74 μg m-3). Most RCM applications assume that concentrations respond linearly to emissions; over the 20-year period investigated, during which most PM2.5 precursor emissions declined ~37–65%, we find only modest evidence of nonlinearities. These findings support the use of RCMs for many policy analysis and other applications for which the slight loss of accuracy compared to CTMs is tolerable, especially given RCM benefits. Common benefits of RCMs include increased computational efficiency and accessibility of air pollution modeling.
abstract_zh: 长期暴露于细颗粒物（PM2.5）与死亡率上升有关。化学输送模型（CTM）常被用于评估美国的PM2.5法规，但其计算成本高昂，且需要大量技术专长。降阶模型（RCM）是为估计由PM2.5及其前体物排放所导致的环境PM2.5浓度而设计的、计算高效的空气质量模型。我们评估了三种被广泛使用的降阶模型（AP3、EASIUR和InMAP）再现1990—2010年间PM2.5浓度变化的能力。与观测到的分组分PM2.5浓度变化相比，降阶模型显示出较强的相关性（R=0.61至0.66）和较低的平均误差（0.84至1.03 μg/m³），其表现与化学输送模型相当（R=0.72，误差=0.74 μg/m³）。大多数降阶模型应用假定浓度对排放呈线性响应；在所考察的20年间，大多数PM2.5前体物排放下降了约37%至65%，我们仅发现了适度的非线性证据。这些发现支持在许多政策分析及其他应用中使用降阶模型，相比化学输送模型，其精度的轻微损失是可以接受的，尤其是考虑到降阶模型的优势。降阶模型的常见优点包括计算效率的提高，以及空气污染建模的可及性增强。

title: Funding a Just Transition Away from Coal in the U.S. Considering Avoided Damage from Air Pollution
abstract: Coal is declining in the U.S. as part of the clean energy transition, resulting in remarkable air pollution benefits for the American public and significant costs for the industry. Using the AP3 integrated assessment model, we estimate that fewer emissions of sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and primary fine particulate matter driven by coal’s decline led to $300 billion in benefits from 2014 to 2019. Conversely, we find that job losses driven by less coal plant and mining activity resulted in $7.84 billion in foregone wages over the same timeframe. While the benefits were greatly distributed (mostly throughout the East), costs were highly concentrated in coal communities. Transferring a small fraction of the benefits to workers could cover these costs while maintaining societal net benefits. Forecasting coal fleet damages from 2020 to 2035, we find that buying out or replacing these plants would result in $589 billion in air quality benefits, which considerably outweigh the costs. The return on investment increases when policy targets the most damaging capacity, and net benefits are maximized when removing just facilities where marginal benefits exceed marginal costs. Evaluating competitive reverse auction policy designs akin to Germany’s Coal Exit Act, we find that adjusting bids based on monetary damages rather than based only on carbon dioxide emissions – the German design – provides a welfare advantage. Our benefit–cost analyses clearly support policies that drive a swift and just transition away from coal, thereby clearing the air while supporting communities needing assistance.
abstract_zh: 作为清洁能源转型的一部分，煤炭在美国持续衰落，这为美国公众带来了显著的空气污染效益，也给煤炭行业带来了重大成本。利用AP3综合评估模型，我们估计，煤炭衰落所带来的二氧化硫、氮氧化物和一次细颗粒物排放减少，在2014至2019年间产生了3000亿美元的效益。相反，我们发现，燃煤电厂和采矿活动减少所导致的就业损失，在同一时期造成了78.4亿美元的工资损失。虽然效益分布广泛（主要在东部地区），但成本高度集中在煤炭社区。将一小部分效益转移给工人，即可在维持社会净收益的同时弥补这些成本。预测2020至2035年间煤电机组造成的损害，我们发现，收购或替代这些电厂将带来5890亿美元的空气质量效益，大大超过其成本。当政策瞄准损害最大的产能时，投资回报率会提高；而仅关闭边际效益超过边际成本的设施时，净收益最大。在评估类似德国《煤炭退出法》的竞争性逆向拍卖政策设计时，我们发现，依据货币化损害而非仅依据二氧化碳排放来调整投标价格（即德国的设计）具有福利优势。我们的效益—成本分析清楚地支持那些推动迅速、公正地淘汰煤炭的政策，从而在为需要帮助的社区提供支持的同时，改善空气质量。

title: Marginal abatement costs for greenhouse gas emissions in the United States using an energy systems approach
abstract: Deep decarbonization requires fundamental changes in meeting energy service demands, with some efforts increasing overall costs. Examining abatement measures in isolation, however, fails to capture their interactive effects within the energy system. Here we show the abatement costs of decarbonization in the United States using an energy system optimization model to capture technological interactions, multi-decadal path dependence, and endogenous end-use technology selection. Energy-system-wide net-zero CO2-eq emissions are achieved in 2050 at a cost under $400 per tonne CO2-eq, led by emissions reductions in power generation, end-use electrification of ground transportation, space heating, and some industrial applications. Differences in mitigation costs and CO2 geological storage potential lead to regional heterogeneities in mitigation rates and residual emissions. The marginal abatement cost curves show that additional decarbonization comes at higher incremental costs, this cost penalty decreases over time, and substantially greater abatement occurs in future time periods at the same abatement cost.
abstract_zh: 深度脱碳需要在满足能源服务需求的方式上进行根本性变革，其中一些努力会增加总成本。然而，孤立地考察减排措施，无法捕捉其在能源系统内部的相互作用效应。在此，我们利用能源系统优化模型，以捕捉技术相互作用、多十年路径依赖以及内生的终端使用技术选择，给出了美国脱碳的减排成本。在2050年，整个能源系统实现了净零CO2当量排放，成本低于每吨CO2当量400美元，主要减排来自发电部门、地面交通的终端电气化、空间供暖以及部分工业应用。减排成本和CO2地质封存潜力的差异，导致各地区减排速度和残余排放存在异质性。边际减排成本曲线表明，进一步脱碳的增量成本越来越高，这种成本负担随时间下降，而在未来的时期，相同的减排成本可实现大幅更多的减排。

title: Measuring and Accounting for Environmental Public Goods A National Accounts Perspective
Socially vulnerable communities face disproportionate exposure and susceptibility to US wildfire and prescribed burn smoke
abstract: While air pollution from most U.S. sources has decreased, emissions from wildland fires have risen. Here, we use an integrated assessment model to estimate that wildfire and prescribed burn smoke caused $200 billion in health damages in 2017, associated with 20,000 premature deaths. Nearly half of this damage came from wildfires, predominantly in the West, with the remainder from prescribed burns, mostly in the Southeast. Our analysis reveals positive correlations between smoke exposure and various social vulnerability measures; however, when also considering smoke susceptibility, these disparities are systematically influenced by age. Senior citizens, who are disproportionately White, represented 16% of the population but incurred 75% of the damages. Nonetheless, within most age groups, Native American and Black communities experienced the greatest damages per capita. Our work highlights the extraordinary and disproportionate effects of the growing threat of fire smoke and calls for targeted, equitable policy solutions for a healthier future.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国大部分污染源的空气污染已经下降，但野火排放却有所上升。在此，我们利用一个综合评估模型估计，2017年野火和计划烧除产生的烟雾造成了2000亿美元的健康损失，并与20,000例过早死亡相关。这些损失近一半来自主要发生在西部的野火，其余则来自主要发生在东南部的计划烧除。我们的分析揭示了烟雾暴露与多种社会脆弱性指标之间存在正相关关系；然而，当同时考虑烟雾易感性时，这些差异会受到年龄的系统性影响。老年人口（其中白人占比过高）占总人口的16%，却承担了75%的损失。尽管如此，在大多数年龄组中，美国原住民社区和黑人社区的人均损失最大。我们的研究凸显了日益严重的火灾烟雾威胁所带来的极端且不成比例的影响，并呼吁制定有针对性、公平的政策方案，以实现更健康的未来。

title: The Role of Hydrogen in Decarbonizing US Iron and Steel Production
abstract: High Resolution Image Download MS PowerPoint Slide This study investigates the role of hydrogen as a decarbonization strategy for the iron and steel industry in the United States (U.S.) in the presence of an economy-wide net zero CO 2 emissions target. Our analysis shows that hydrogen-based direct reduced iron (H 2 DRI) provides a cost-effective decarbonization strategy only under a relatively narrow set of conditions. Using today’s best estimates of the capital and variable costs of alternative decarbonized iron and steelmaking technologies in a U.S. economy-wide simulation framework, we find that carbon capture technologies can achieve comparable decarbonization levels by 2050 and greater cumulative emissions reductions from iron and steel production at a lower cost. Simulations suggest hydrogen contributes to economy-wide decarbonization, but H 2 DRI is not the preferred use case for hydrogen in most scenarios. The average abatement cost for U.S. iron and steel production could be as low as $70/tonne CO 2 with existing technologies plus carbon capture, while the cost with H 2 DRI rises to over $500/tonne CO 2 . We also find that IRA tax credits are insufficient to spur hydrogen use in steelmaking in our model and that a green steel production tax credit would need to be as high as $300/tonne steel to lead to sustained H 2 DRI use.

title: Firewood in the American Economy: 1700 to 2010
abstract: Despite the central role of firewood in the development of the early American economy, prices for this energy fuel are absent from official government statistics and the scholarly literature. This paper presents the most comprehensive dataset of firewood prices in the United States compiled to date, encompassing over 6,000 price quotes from 1700 to 2010. Between 1700 and 2010, real firewood prices increased by between 0.2% and 0.4%, annually, and from 1800 to the Civil War, real prices increased especially rapidly, between 0.7% and 1% per year. Rising firewood prices and falling coal prices led to the transition to coal as the primary energy fuel. Between 1860 and 1890, the income elasticity for firewood switched from 0.5 to -0.5. Beginning in the last decade of the 18th century, firewood output increased from about 18% of GDP to just under 30% of GDP in the 1830s. The value of firewood fell to less than 5% of GDP by the 1880s. Prior estimates of firewood output in the 19th century significantly underestimated its value. Finally, incorporating the new estimates of firewood output into agricultural production leads to higher estimates of agricultural productivity growth prior to 1860 than previously reported in the literature. abstract_zh: 尽管柴火在美国早期经济发展中占据核心地位，但这一能源燃料的价格却未被官方政府统计和学术文献所收录。本文提供了迄今为止汇编的最全面的美国柴火价格数据集，涵盖了1700年至2010年间6000多条价格报价。1700至2010年间，柴火的实际价格年均上涨0.2%至0.4%；从1800年到南北战争期间，实际价格上涨尤为迅速，年均上涨0.7%至1%。柴火价格上升与煤炭价格下降共同促成了煤炭成为主要能源燃料的转变。1860至1890年间，柴火的收入弹性由0.5转为-0.5。自18世纪最后十年起，柴火产出占GDP的比重由约18%上升至19世纪30年代的略低于30%。到19世纪80年代，柴火的价值降至占GDP不足5%。以往对19世纪柴火产出的估计严重低估了其价值。最后，将柴火产出的新估计纳入农业生产核算后，得出的1860年以前农业生产率增长估计值高于以往文献的报告。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Geographic Resolution in Environmental Policy: EPA's Shift from Regions to Counties Under the Clean Air Act
abstract: Prior to 1978 EPA regulated nonattainment with the Clean Air Act using Air Quality Control Regions (AQCRs), switching to counties in 1978. This paper investigates the implications of this change for ambient pollution and manufacturing employment. We find that EPA’s official AQCR nonattainment designation for total suspended particulate matter (TSP) in 1972 had no causal effect on ambient TSP. Nor do we detect robust causal evidence that being in nonattainment in the AQCR regime affected employment in pollution intensive manufacturing industries. In contrast, using an imputed definition of 1972 nonattainment based on county level monitor readings, we find evidence that nonattainment decreased ambient TSP and manufacturing employment. After 1978, when EPA officially adopted county level nonattainment designations, both ambient TSP and manufacturing employment in pollution intensive industries declined. We discuss the implications of these findings for EPA’s decision regarding the geographic level at which to regulate air pollution. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 1978年之前，EPA依据空气质量控制区（AQCR）对《清洁空气法》下的未达标状况进行监管，1978年起改为以县为单位。本文考察了这一变化对环境空气污染和制造业就业的影响。我们发现，EPA在1972年对总悬浮颗粒物（TSP）作出的官方AQCR未达标认定对环境TSP没有因果效应。我们也未发现可靠的因果证据表明，在AQCR制度下处于未达标状态会影响污染密集型制造业的就业。与之相反，利用基于县级监测读数推算的1972年未达标定义，我们发现未达标确实降低了环境TSP和制造业就业。1978年之后，EPA正式采用县级未达标认定，此后环境TSP和污染密集型行业的制造业就业均有所下降。我们讨论了这些发现对EPA关于空气污染监管地理层级决策的启示。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可免费下载本文，网址为 www.nber.org。

title: Climate Policy Reduces Racial Disparities in Air Pollution from Transportation and Power Generation
abstract: High Resolution Image Download MS PowerPoint Slide Energy system optimization models facilitate analyses on a national or regional scale. However, understanding the impacts of climate policy on specific populations requires a much higher spatial resolution. Here, we link an energy system optimization model to an integrated assessment model via an emission downscaling algorithm, translating air pollution emissions from nine U.S. regions to U.S. counties. We simulate the impacts of six distinct policy scenarios, including a current policy and a 2050 net-zero target, on NO x, SO 2, and PM 2.5 emissions from on-road transportation and electricity generation. We compare different policies based on their ability to reduce emission exposure and exposure disparity across racial groups, allowing decision-makers to assess the air pollution impacts of various policy instruments more holistically. Modeled policies include a clean electricity standard, an on-road ICE vehicle ban, a carbon tax, and a scenario that reaches net-zero GHG emissions by 2050. While exposure and disparities decrease in all scenarios, our results reveal persistent disparities until at least 2040, particularly for Black non-Hispanic Americans. Our estimates of avoided deaths due to air pollution emphasize the importance of policy timing, showing that thousands of lives can be saved by taking action in the near-term.
abstract_zh: 高分辨率图像下载 MS PowerPoint幻灯片 能源系统优化模型便于在国家或区域尺度上开展分析。然而，要理解气候政策对特定人群的影响，需要更高的空间分辨率。在此，我们通过排放降尺度算法，将能源系统优化模型与综合评估模型相连接，把美国九个地区的空气污染排放转换到美国县级层面。我们模拟了六种不同政策情景（包括当前政策以及2050年净零目标）对道路交通和发电产生的NOx、SO2和PM2.5排放的影响。我们依据各政策降低排放暴露以及减少不同种族群体间暴露不平等的能力，对其进行比较，使决策者能够更全面地评估各种政策工具的空气污染影响。所模拟的政策包括清洁电力标准、道路内燃机汽车禁令、碳税，以及到2050年实现温室气体净零排放的情景。虽然所有情景下暴露和不平等都有所下降，但我们的结果显示，至少到2040年仍存在持续的不平等，尤其是对于美国非西班牙裔黑人。我们对空气污染导致的可避免死亡的估计，强调了政策时机的重要性，表明近期采取行动即可挽救数千人的生命。

title: Measuring global monetary damages from particulate matter and carbon dioxide emissions to track sustainable growth
abstract: An integrated framework that tracks global stocks and flows of natural capital is needed to assess sustainable economic growth. Here, we develop a set of globally comprehensive monetary damages from particulate matter air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions in 165 countries from 1998 to 2018. Our results show that pollution intensity began to rise after a decade during which the global economy became less pollution-intensive from the late 1990s until the Great Recession. Larger economic production shares and higher pollution intensity in China and India drove this change. Deducting pollution damage from output from the late 1990s until the Great Recession yields higher growth estimates. After the Great Recession, this adjustment for pollution damage attenuated growth. We show that modeling monetary damages instead of physical measures of environmental quality affects inferences about sustainable development. Further, the monetary damages from exposure to particulate emissions peak earlier in the development path than damages due to carbon dioxide emissions. Monetary damages peak later than physical measures of both pollutants. For carbon dioxide, per capita emissions maximize at just over 60,000 dollars while monetary damages peak at nearly 80,000 dollars. In 2018, all but two countries were below this income level. Our results suggest that the global economy is likely to exhibit rising damages from particulates and carbon dioxide emissions in the years to come as nations grow and develop.
abstract_zh: 要评估可持续的经济增长，需要一个追踪自然资本全球存量与流量的综合框架。在此，我们构建了1998至2018年间165个国家颗粒物空气污染和温室气体排放所造成的全面全球货币化损害数据集。我们的结果表明，在20世纪90年代末至大衰退期间，全球经济的污染强度下降了十年后，污染强度开始上升。中国和印度的较大经济产出份额和较高的污染强度推动了这一变化。在20世纪90年代末至大衰退期间，从产出中扣除污染损害后，增长估计值更高。大衰退之后，对污染损害的这一调整则减缓了增长。我们表明，以货币化损害而非环境质量的物理指标进行建模，会影响对可持续发展的推断。此外，颗粒物排放所造成的货币化损害，在发展路径上比二氧化碳排放造成的损害更早达到峰值。货币化损害的峰值晚于两种污染物的物理指标峰值。对于二氧化碳，人均排放在略高于6万美元时达到最大，而货币化损害则在接近8万美元时达到峰值。到2018年，除两个国家外，其余所有国家都低于这一收入水平。我们的结果表明，随着各国经济增长和发展，全球经济未来几年很可能呈现颗粒物和二氧化碳排放损害不断上升的趋势。

title: Productivity and the Environmental Accounts
Closing the Gap: Achieving U.S. climate goals beyond the Inflation Reduction Act
abstract: The Inflation Reduction Act sets the stage for substantial greenhouse gas emissions reduction in the United States. However, analyses show that on its own, the IRA is insufficient to meet the nation's stated climate goals. We use an energy system optimization model to understand how the U.S. can build on the IRA to meet climate goals. We model two carbon taxes and a suite of efficiency, fuel, and technology standards, including a clean electricity standard (CES), electrification standards for commercial and residential buildings, a zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) standard, and a clean fuel standard for industry. We compare these three policy scenarios to the U.S.’s stated climate goals (Nationally Determined Contribution). The two carbon taxes and the suite of standards achieve the GHG emissions goals outlined in the Paris Agreement, but no scenario reaches net-zero GHG emissions by 2050. Notably, we find that the average GHG abatement cost under the modeled standards is comparable to a carbon tax set at ∼$200/ton, and both policies achieve similar emissions reductions. Temoa's cost-minimization structure results in the carbon tax always reducing emissions more cheaply than a set of standards; but the similarity in cost emphasizes the near-optimal second-best nature of well-designed standards.” The marginal cost of GHG emissions reduction in each scenario is less than 2% of total system costs. While the modeling results indicate that meeting climate targets may still be possible, they demonstrate that doing so will require rapid and sustained deployment of zero-emission technologies across the energy system.
abstract_zh: 《通胀削减法案》（IRA）为美国大幅减少温室气体排放奠定了基础。然而，分析表明，仅凭IRA本身不足以实现美国自身宣布的气候目标。我们利用能源系统优化模型，探讨美国如何在IRA的基础上实现气候目标。我们模拟了两种碳税，以及一系列效率、燃料和技术标准，包括清洁电力标准（CES）、商业和住宅建筑的电气化标准、零排放汽车（ZEV）标准以及工业清洁燃料标准。我们将这三种政策情景与美国宣布的气候目标（国家自主贡献，NDC）进行比较。两种碳税和这一系列标准均可实现《巴黎协定》中所列的温室气体减排目标，但没有任何情景能够在2050年实现温室气体净零排放。值得注意的是，我们发现，所模拟标准下的平均温室气体减排成本，与设定为每吨约200美元的碳税相当，且两种政策实现的减排量相近。Temoa的成本最小化结构使碳税总是比一组标准更便宜地减少排放；但成本的相似性凸显了设计良好的标准作为次优选择时接近最优的性质。”每种情景下温室气体减排的边际成本都不到系统总成本的2%。尽管建模结果表明实现气候目标仍有可能，但它们也表明，要做到这一点，需要在整个能源系统中迅速且持续地部署零排放技术。

title: The impact of the clean air act on particulate matter in the 1970s
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We examine whether counties designated as out of attainment with the National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) under the 1970 CAA experienced larger reductions in Total Suspended Particulates (TSP) during the 1970s than attainment counties. We answer this question using the official designation of nonattainment status which, between 1972 and 1978, was by Air Quality Control Region (AQCR).Data from balanced panels of TSP monitors in operation from 1969-78 and from 1971-78 are used to examine the impact of nonattainment status on TSP.We also examine the impact of nonattainment on TSP using the definition in the literature, which designates a county as out of attainment if any of its monitors violated the NAAQS.Using the official (AQCR) nonattainment designation, TSP, on average, fell by 10.2 μg/m3 using the 1969 panel and 9.1 μg/m3 using the 1971 panel. Using the definition of nonattainment in the literature yields smaller reductions: 6.0 μg/m3 using the 1969-78 panel and 7.7 μg/m3 using the 1971-78 panel. Using the correct definition of nonattainment in difference-in-differences (DID) models calls into question whether these results can be interpreted as causal. When counties are characterized using the official nonattainment designation, the parallel trends assumption, crucial to causal inference in the DID context, is violated.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在1970年《清洁空气法》（CAA）下被划定为未达到国家环境空气质量标准（NAAQS）的县，在20世纪70年代是否比达标县经历了更大幅度的总悬浮颗粒物（TSP）下降。我们利用1972年至1978年间按空气质量控制区（AQCR）划定的官方不达标状态来回答这一问题。我们使用1969年至1978年以及1971年至1978年期间持续运行的平衡面板TSP监测数据，考察不达标状态对TSP的影响。我们还采用文献中的定义考察了不达标的影响，即若一个县中任一监测站曾违反NAAQS，则将该县划为不达标。采用官方（AQCR）的不达标划定，TSP平均下降了10.2 μg/m3（使用1969年面板）和9.1 μg/m3（使用1971年面板）。采用文献中的不达标定义，下降幅度较小：使用1969-78年面板为6.0 μg/m3，使用1971-78年面板为7.7 μg/m3。在双重差分（DID）模型中采用正确的不达标定义，使这些结果能否被解释为因果效应受到质疑。当以官方不达标划定来刻画各县时，双重差分因果推断中至关重要的平行趋势假设被违反。

title: Distributional Weights in Economic Analysis
abstract: The use of distributional weights in economic analysis is receiving increasing attention in both research and policy circles. This paper examines the extent to which distributional weights affect economic analysis of public good provision. We make two contributions. First, we present a model with distributional weights that allows for marginal benefits and costs of the public good to differ across regions and individual characteristics, such as income or race. Samuelson’s analysis of pure public goods is a special case, as are other cases in which marginal benefits and costs may differ by region when the distributional weights are unity. We show how the provision of a pure public good varies with distributional weights different from unity. Second, we analyze distributional weights in conjunction with the value of a statistical life (VSL). We compare the use of an average VSL with differentiated VSLs. We show when using an average VSL will increase or decrease optimal public goods provision relative to differentiated VSLs for given distributional weights. We also identify conditions under which a low-income group prefers using an average VSL to true VSLs. This depends on the fraction of the costs that the low-income group bears in the provision of the public good.

title: Greenhouse Gas Estimates of LNG Exports Must Include Global Market Effects
abstract: High Resolution Image Download MS PowerPoint Slide We conduct a consequential lifecycle analysis (LCA) of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from North American liquefied natural gas (LNG) export projects, estimating the change in global natural gas and coal use resulting from the market effects of increased LNG trade. We estimate that building a 2.1 billion cubic feet per day (Bcfd) LNG export facility, equivalent to one of the larger LNG projects under development in the US today, will change global GHG emissions −39 to 11 Mt CO 2 e (90% range) with a median value of −8 Mt CO 2 e. Previous attributional LCA methods for electricity generation with LNG replacing coal find a much larger benefit of LNG exports, a median value of −36 Mt CO 2 e for this size project. The smaller decrease in GHGs is attributable to higher domestic coal use and a smaller decrease in international coal use than assumed by previous methods. Net global emission change estimates are most sensitive to the uncertainty in economic elasticities outside of North America. Given the scale of planned and proposed LNG export terminals, project regulators and policymakers must account for market effects to more accurately estimate the global net change in GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 高分辨率图像下载 MS PowerPoint幻灯片 我们对北美液化天然气（LNG）出口项目的温室气体（GHG）排放进行了后果性生命周期分析（LCA），估计LNG贸易增加的市场效应所导致的全球天然气和煤炭使用变化。我们估计，建设一座日输送21亿立方英尺（Bcfd）的LNG出口设施（相当于当今美国正在开发的较大LNG项目之一），将使全球温室气体排放变化在−3900万至1100万吨CO2当量之间（90%区间），中位数为−800万吨CO2当量。以往的归因式LCA方法在考虑LNG替代煤炭发电时，发现LNG出口的效益要大得多，同等规模项目的中位数为−3600万吨CO2当量。温室气体减排幅度较小，原因在于国内煤炭使用增加，以及与以往方法相比国际煤炭使用的减少幅度更小。全球净排放变化估计对北美以外经济弹性的不确定性最为敏感。鉴于计划和拟建的LNG出口终端的规模，项目监管者和政策制定者必须考虑市场效应，以更准确地估计温室气体排放的全球净变化。

title: Policy spillovers, technological lock-in, and efficiency gains from regional pollution taxes in the U.S.
abstract: We used the US-TIMES energy-system model in conjunction with integrated assessment models for air pollution (AP3, EASIUR, InMAP) to estimate the consequences of local air pollutant (LAP) and carbon dioxide (CO2) policy on technology-choice, energy-system costs, emissions, and pollution damages in the United States. We report substantial policy spillover: Both LAP and CO2 taxes cause similar levels of decarbonization. Under LAP taxes, decarbonization was a result of an increase in natural gas generation and a near-complete phaseout of coal generation in the electric sector. Under a CO2 tax, the majority of simulated decarbonization was a result of increased electric generation from wind and solar. We also found that the timing of the CO2 and LAP taxes was important. When we simulated a LAP tax beginning in 2015 and waited until 2025 to introduce a CO2 tax, the electric sector was locked into higher levels of natural gas generation and cumulative 2010–2035 energy system CO2 emissions were 8.8 billion tons higher than when the taxes were implemented simultaneously. A scenario taxing CO2 and LAPs simultaneously beginning in 2015 produced the highest net benefits, as opposed to scenarios that target either CO2 or LAPs, or scenarios that delayed either LAP or CO2 taxes until 2025. Lastly, we found that net benefits compared to business as usual are higher under a regional versus a national LAP-tax regime, but that efficiency gains under the regional tax are not substantially higher than those under the national LAP-tax policy.
abstract_zh: 我们将美国TIMES能源系统模型与用于空气污染的综合评估模型（AP3、EASIUR、InMAP）结合使用，估计地方空气污染物（LAP）和二氧化碳（CO2）政策对美国技术选择、能源系统成本、排放和污染损害的影响。我们发现了显著的政策溢出效应：LAP税和CO2税都会带来相近程度的脱碳。在LAP税下，脱碳的结果是天然气发电增加，同时电力部门的煤电几乎被彻底淘汰。在CO2税下，模拟脱碳的大部分来自风电和太阳能发电的增加。我们还发现，CO2税和LAP税的实施时机十分重要。当我们模拟从2015年开始征收LAP税，而推迟到2025年才引入CO2税时，电力部门被锁定在较高的天然气发电水平上，2010至2035年间能源系统的累计CO2排放比两种税同时实施时高出88亿吨。从2015年开始同时对CO2和LAP征税的情景，产生了最高的净收益，优于仅针对CO2或仅针对LAP的情景，也优于将LAP税或CO2税推迟到2025年的情景。最后，我们发现，相较于一切照旧的情景，区域性LAP税制度的净收益高于全国性制度，但区域税的效率收益并不显著高于全国性LAP税政策。

title: The hidden value of trees: Quantifying the ecosystem services of tree lineages and their major threats across the contiguous US
abstract: Trees provide critical contributions to human well-being. They sequester and store greenhouse gasses, filter air pollutants, provide wood, food, and other products, among other benefits. These benefits are threatened by climate change, fires, pests and pathogens. To quantify the current value of the flow of ecosystem services from U.S. trees, and the threats they face, we combine macroevolutionary and economic valuation approaches using spatially explicit data about tree species and lineages. We find that the value of five key ecosystem services with adequate data generated by US trees is $114 billion per annum (low: $85 B; high: $137 B; 2010 USD). The non-market value of trees from carbon storage and air pollution removal far exceed their commercial value from wood products and food crops. Two lineages—pines and oaks—account for 42% of the value of these services. The majority of species face threats from climate change, many face increasing fire risk, and known pests and pathogens threaten 40% of total woody biomass. The most valuable US tree species and lineages are among those most threatened by known pests and pathogens, with species most valuable for carbon storage most at risk from increasing fire threat. High turnover of tree species across the continent results in a diverse set of species distributed across the tree of life contributing to ecosystem services in the U.S. The high diversity of taxa across U.S. forests may be important in buffering ecosystem service losses if and when the most valuable lineages are compromised.
abstract_zh: 树木对人类福祉作出了关键贡献。它们吸收并储存温室气体，过滤空气污染物，提供木材、食物及其他产品，还有其他诸多益处。这些益处正受到气候变化、火灾、害虫和病原体的威胁。为量化美国树木所提供生态系统服务流的当前价值及其面临的威胁，我们结合宏观进化与经济估值方法，利用关于树种和谱系的空间明确数据进行分析。我们发现，美国树木提供的、数据充分的五项关键生态系统服务价值为每年1140亿美元（低值：850亿美元；高值：1370亿美元；2010年美元）。树木在碳储存和空气污染去除方面的非市场价值，远超其在木材产品和粮食作物方面的商业价值。松树和栎树两个谱系占这些服务价值的42%。大多数物种面临气候变化的威胁，许多物种面临日益增加的火灾风险，而已知的害虫和病原体威胁着木本生物量总量的40%。美国最有价值的树种和谱系，恰恰也是受已知害虫和病原体威胁最大的那些，而对碳储存最为重要的物种，则面临火灾威胁增加的最大风险。全大陆树种的高度更替，使得分布于生命之树各个分支上的多样化物种共同为美国的生态系统服务作出贡献。美国森林中丰富的类群多样性，在最有价值的谱系受到损害时，可能对缓冲生态系统服务的损失起到重要作用。

title: The Role of Information in the Market Response to Flood Risk: Hurricane Katrina and the New Jersey Coast
abstract: This study uses hedonic property models to explore how coastal real estate markets subject to heterogeneous information treatments respond to flood risk. We identify reactions to flood risk, distinctly from price effects due to flood damage, by examining non-local flooding events.  Utilizing a difference-in-differences methodology, we test whether the coastal real estate market in New Jersey responds to several well-publicized hurricanes that did not strike the Atlantic seaboard. We find that homes in high flood risk zones situated in towns that participate in public flood awareness activities incur a 7 to 16 percent decrease in price after the non-local shock. Further, we show that firms are more responsive to risk information than individuals and that markets exposed to such information are less adversely affected by future disasters.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用特征价格模型，探讨在信息处理各不相同的情况下，沿海房地产市场如何对洪水风险做出反应。通过考察非本地洪水事件，我们将对洪水风险的反应与洪水损失造成的价格效应区分开来。利用双重差分方法，我们检验新泽西州沿海房地产市场是否会对几场广为报道、但并未袭击大西洋沿岸的飓风做出反应。我们发现，位于参与公共洪水宣传活动的城镇内、处于高洪水风险区的住房，在非本地冲击之后价格下降了7%至16%。此外，我们表明，企业比个人对风险信息的反应更为敏感，而接触此类信息的市场在未来灾害中受到的不利影响也较小。

title: War, Influenza, and U.S. Carbon Intensity
abstract: Carbon intensity from fossil fuel use in the United States economy peaked in 1917. World War I ended, and the Spanish Flu pandemic broke out one year later in 1918. This paper contends that these events, coupled with associated turmoil in the domestic coal industry, were largely responsible for the turning point in carbon intensity. It is instructive to consider that geopolitics, labor markets, and public health at the time of peak carbon intensity bear relevance to the global economy from 2019 to the present. Interventions in markets intended to mitigate detrimental consequences of pandemic and war may induce ancillary impacts for long-run climate change and environmental quality.
abstract_zh: 美国经济中化石燃料使用的碳强度在1917年达到峰值。第一次世界大战结束，次年即1918年，西班牙流感大流行爆发。本文认为，这些事件，加上当时国内煤炭行业的相关动荡，在很大程度上是碳强度出现转折点的原因。值得注意的是，碳强度达到峰值时期的地缘政治、劳动力市场和公共卫生，与2019年至今的全球经济仍有关联。旨在减轻疫情和战争不利后果的市场干预，可能会对长期气候变化和环境质量产生附带影响。

title: Expected Health Effects of Reduced Air Pollution from COVID-19 Social Distancing
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in stay-at-home policies and other social distancing behaviors in the United States in spring of 2020. This paper examines the impact that these actions had on emissions and expected health effects through reduced personal vehicle travel and electricity consumption. Using daily cell phone mobility data for each U.S. county, we find that vehicle travel dropped about 40% by mid-April across the nation. States that imposed stay-at-home policies before March 28 decreased travel slightly more than other states, but travel in all states decreased significantly. Using data on hourly electricity consumption by electricity region (e.g., balancing authority), we find that electricity consumption fell about 6% on average by mid-April with substantial heterogeneity. Given these decreases in travel and electricity use, we estimate the county-level expected improvements in air quality, and, therefore, expected declines in mortality. Overall, we estimate that, for a month of social distancing, the expected premature deaths due to air pollution from personal vehicle travel and electricity consumption declined by approximately 360 deaths, or about 25% of the baseline 1500 deaths. In addition, we estimate that CO2 emissions from these sources fell by 46 million metric tons (a reduction of approximately 19%) over the same time frame.
abstract_zh: 2020年春季，COVID-19疫情在美国催生了居家令及其他保持社交距离的措施。本文考察了这些行动通过减少私家车出行和用电，对排放及预期健康影响产生的作用。利用美国每个县的每日手机移动数据，我们发现，到4月中旬，全国车辆出行量下降了约40%。在3月28日之前实施居家政策的州，其出行量下降幅度略大于其他州，但所有州的出行量都显著下降。利用各电力区域（如平衡管理机构）的每小时用电数据，我们发现，到4月中旬，用电量平均下降约6%，且存在显著的异质性。鉴于出行和用电量的下降，我们估计了县级层面空气质量的预期改善，从而估计了预期死亡率的下降。总体而言，我们估计，在一个月的社交隔离期间，由私家车出行和用电造成的空气污染导致的预期过早死亡减少了约360人，约占基准1500例死亡的25%。此外，我们估计，在同一时期，这些来源的CO2排放减少了4600万公吨（约减少19%）。

title: Heterogeneous Solar Capacity Benefits, Appropriability, and the Costs of Suboptimal Siting
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper estimates that pollution damages avoidable by solar capacity vary considerably across zip codes in the United States and that they are uncorrelated with solar subsidy levels in each state. We estimate that $1 billion in avoided pollution damages would be gained annually from optimal siting of installed rooftop solar capacity. States are shown to appropriate a minority of these benefits from their solar investments because of interstate electricity and air pollution flows. This paper further measures the energy value of solar capacity across the United States and finds that rooftop solar does not relieve grid congestion.
abstract_zh: 本文估计，太阳能装机容量可避免的污染损害，在美国各邮政编码地区之间差异很大，且与各州的太阳能补贴水平无关。我们估计，若屋顶太阳能装机选址最优，每年可避免的污染损害可达10亿美元。研究表明，由于州际电力和空气污染的流动，各州只能占有其太阳能投资所产生的这些效益中的少数部分。本文还进一步衡量了美国各地太阳能装机的能源价值，发现屋顶太阳能并不能缓解电网拥堵。

title: Mortality Risk from PM2.5: A Comparison of Modeling Approaches to Identify Disparities across Racial/Ethnic Groups in Policy Outcomes
abstract: BACKGROUND: )]. Common practice by U.S. federal agencies involves using underlying health data and concentration-response functions that are not differentiated by racial/ethnic group. OBJECTIVES: We aim to explore the policy implications of using race/ethnicity-specific concentration-response functions and mortality data in comparison to standard approaches when estimating the impact of air pollution on non-White racial/ethnic subgroups. METHODS: Using new estimates from the epidemiological literature on race/ethnicity-specific concentration-response functions paired with race/ethnicity-specific mortality rates, we estimated the mortality impacts of air pollution from all sources from a uniform increase in concentrations and from the regulations imposed by the Mercury Air Toxics Standards. RESULTS: the benefits to older White Americans by 14% relative to using a race/ethnicity-specific modeling approach. DISCUSSION: mortality burden and the disparity in impacts on older Black American populations. Based on our results, we recommend that the best available race/ethnicity-specific inputs are used in regulatory assessments to understand and reduce environmental injustices. https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP9001.
abstract_zh: 背景：)]。美国联邦机构的常见做法是使用基础健康数据和浓度—反应函数，而这些数据和函数并不区分种族/族裔群体。目的：在估计空气污染对非白人种族/族裔亚群体的影响时，我们旨在探讨与标准方法相比，使用分种族/族裔的浓度—反应函数和死亡率数据所带来的政策含义。方法：利用流行病学文献中关于分种族/族裔浓度—反应函数的新估计，并与分种族/族裔的死亡率相配对，我们估计了所有来源的空气污染在浓度均匀上升时，以及《汞空气有毒物质标准》所施加的监管下的死亡影响。结果：与采用分种族/族裔建模方法相比，对年长白人美国人的效益高出14%。讨论：死亡负担，以及对年长黑人美国人群体影响的不平等。基于我们的结果，我们建议在监管评估中使用现有最佳的分种族/族裔输入数据，以理解并减少环境不公。https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP9001。

title: Recent Increases in Air Pollution: Evidence and Implications for Mortality
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: After declining by 27.4 percent from 2009 to 2016, annual average fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in the United States in counties with monitors increased by 5.7 percent between 2016 and 2018. Increases occurred in multiple census regions and in counties that were in and out of attainment with National Ambient Air Quality Standards. This article explores channels through which the increase may have occurred, including increases in economic activity, increases in wildfires, and decreases in Clean Air Act enforcement actions. We find that the health implications of the increase in PM2.5 are significant. The increase was associated with 9,700 additional premature deaths between 2016 and 2018, which, based on conventional valuation methods, represent damages of $89 billion.
abstract_zh: 2009年至2016年间，美国设有监测站的各县年均细颗粒物（PM2.5）浓度下降了27.4%，而2016年至2018年间则上升了5.7%。这一上升出现在多个人口普查区域，并且在达到和未达到《国家环境空气质量标准》的各县均有出现。本文探讨了可能导致这一上升的渠道，包括经济活动增加、野火增多以及《清洁空气法》执法行动减少。我们发现，PM2.5上升的健康影响十分显著。这一上升与2016年至2018年间额外9,700例过早死亡相关，按照常规估值方法，相当于890亿美元的损失。

title: The environmental benefits of transportation electrification: Urban buses
Measuring Firm Environmental Performance to Inform Asset Management and Standardized Disclosure
abstract: Investing according to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria is gaining momentum. Most environmental performance indices focus only on the tonnage of carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. This paper proposes an index covering eight pollutants expressed in monetary damage. Inclusion of multiple pollutants reflects a broader range of reputational and regulatory risks. Monetization appropriately weights emissions. CO2 dominates the mass of other pollutants, yet the marginal damages from other pollutants are larger than CO2. In the U.S. utility sector from 2014 to 2017, indices which only track CO2 mischaracterize firms’ environmental performance and underestimate its effect on financial outcomes relative to the multipollutant index. Dirtier firms exhibit lower share prices and higher forward returns. The effect is twice as large for the multipollutant index compared to CO2. Analysts’ earnings forecasts for dirtier firms systematically undershoot actuals. Earnings errors are between three and five times more sensitive to the multipollutant index than to CO2. The multipollutant index may suggest new management strategies to financial market participants relative to those based on carbon intensity. ESG disclosure standards based on the new index are more likely to affect financial outcomes, capital allocation decisions, and firm behavior than disclosure of carbon intensity.
abstract_zh: 依据环境、社会和治理（ESG）标准进行投资正在兴起。大多数环境绩效指数仅关注二氧化碳（CO2）排放的吨数。本文提出一种以货币化损害表示、涵盖八种污染物的指数。纳入多种污染物反映了更广泛的声誉和监管风险。货币化对排放进行了恰当的加权。CO2在污染物总量中占主导，但其他污染物的边际损害大于CO2。在2014至2017年的美国公用事业部门，仅追踪CO2的指数错误刻画了企业的环境绩效，并且相对于多污染物指数而言，低估了其对财务结果的影响。污染更严重的企业股价更低，未来收益更高。该效应对多污染物指数而言是CO2的两倍。污染更严重企业的分析师盈利预测系统性地低于实际值。盈利误差对多污染物指数的敏感度是CO2的三至五倍。相较于基于碳强度的策略，多污染物指数可能为金融市场参与者提供新的管理策略。基于新指数的ESG披露标准，相比披露碳强度，更有可能影响财务结果、资本配置决策和企业行为。

title: On the Green Interest Rate
abstract: This paper demonstrates how a central bank might operationalize an expanded role inclusive of managing risks from environmental pollution. The analysis introduces the green interest rate (rg) which depends on temporal changes in the pollution intensity of output. This policy instrument reallocates consumption from periods when output is pollution intensive to when output is cleaner. In economies on a cleaning-up path, rg exceeds r*. For those growing more polluted, rg is less than r*. In the U.S. economy from 1957 to 2016, rg exceeded r* by 50 basis points. Federal environmental policy reversed the orientation between rg and r*.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了中央银行如何将其职能拓展至包括管理环境污染风险在内的运作方式。本文引入了绿色利率（rg），它取决于产出污染强度的时间变化。这一政策工具将消费从产出污染密集的时期重新配置到产出较清洁的时期。在走向清洁化的经济体中，rg高于r*；对于日益污染化的经济体，rg则低于r*。在1957至2016年的美国经济中，rg比r*高出50个基点。联邦环境政策扭转了rg与r*之间的方向关系。

title: Decompositions and Policy Consequences of an Extraordinary Decline in Air Pollution from Electricity Generation
abstract: Using integrated assessment models, we calculate the economic value of the extraordinary decline in emissions from US power plants. Annual local and global air pollution damages fell from $245 to $133 billion over 2010–2017. Decomposition shows changes in emission rates and generation shares among coal and gas plants account for more of this decline than changes in renewable generation, electricity consumption, and damage valuations. Econometrically estimated marginal damages declined in the East from 8.6 to 6 cents per kWh. Marginal damages increased slightly in the West and Texas. These estimates indicate electric vehicles are now cleaner on average than gasoline vehicles. (JEL H23, L94, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 利用综合评估模型，我们计算了美国发电厂排放异常大幅下降所带来的经济价值。2010至2017年间，年度地方和全球空气污染损害从2450亿美元下降至1330亿美元。分解结果表明，煤电和气电之间排放率及发电份额的变化，所解释的下降幅度大于可再生能源发电、电力消费和损害估值变化所解释的部分。经计量估计，东部的边际损害由每千瓦时8.6美分下降至6美分。西部和得克萨斯州的边际损害则略有上升。这些估计表明，电动汽车现在平均比汽油车更清洁。（JEL H23, L94, Q53, Q58）

title: Near term carbon tax policy in the US Economy: limits to deep decarbonization
abstract: This paper explores carbon dioxide (CO2) tax policies from 2015 to 2030 in the United States economy using an energy system least-cost optimization model. We report limited near-term decarbonization opportunities outside of the electricity sector, which results in substantial CO2 tax revenue through 2030. Second, because the social cost of carbon is uncertain, we find asymmetric deadweight loss from implementing mistakenly high or low CO2 taxes, providing efficiency-based support for the precautionary principle. Third, despite CO2 reductions occurring mainly in the electric sector, the abatement estimated herein is consistent with the US nationally determined contributions established under the Paris Agreement.
abstract_zh: 本文利用能源系统最小成本优化模型，探讨了2015至2030年美国经济中的二氧化碳（CO2）税政策。我们发现，电力部门之外的近期脱碳机会有限，这导致到2030年前会产生可观的CO2税收入。其次，由于碳的社会成本存在不确定性，实施过高或过低的CO2税均会造成不对称的无谓损失，这为基于效率的预防原则提供了支持。第三，尽管CO2减排主要发生在电力部门，但本文估计的减排量与《巴黎协定》下确立的美国国家自主贡献是一致的。

title: Optimizing Emissions Reductions from the US Power Sector for Climate and Health Benefits
Reducing Mortality from Air Pollution in the United States by Targeting Specific Emission Sources
abstract: Air quality in the United States has dramatically improved, yet exposure to air pollution is still associated with 100000–200000 deaths annually. Reducing the number of deaths effectively, efficiently, and equitably relies on attributing them to specific emission sources, but so far, this has been done for only highly aggregated groups of sources, or a select few sources of interest. Here, we estimate mortality in the United States attributable to all domestic, human-caused emissions of primary PM2.5 and secondary PM2.5 precursors. We present detailed source-specific attributions in four alternate groupings relevant for identifying promising ways to reduce mortality. We find that nearly half of the deaths can be attributed to just five activities, all in different sectors. Around half of the deaths can be attributed to fossil fuel combustion, with the remainder attributable to combustion of nonfossil fuels, agricultural processes, and other noncombustion processes. Both primary and secondary PM2.5 are important, including PM2.5 from currently unregulated precursor pollutants such as ammonia. We suggest improvements in air quality can be realized by continued reductions of emissions from traditionally important sources and by novel strategies for reducing emissions from sources of emerging relative importance and research focus. Such changes can contribute to improved health outcomes and other environmental goals.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国的空气质量已显著改善，但空气污染暴露每年仍与10万至20万例死亡相关。要有效、高效且公平地减少死亡人数，依赖于将死亡归因于具体的排放源，但迄今为止，这一工作仅针对高度聚合的排放源群体，或少数备受关注的排放源开展。本文估算了美国因所有国内人为一次PM2.5和二次PM2.5前体物排放所导致的死亡人数。我们以四种不同的分组方式，给出了与识别降低死亡率的有效途径相关的、详细的分排放源归因结果。我们发现，近一半的死亡可归因于仅五类活动，且这五类活动分属不同部门。约一半的死亡可归因于化石燃料燃烧，其余则归因于非化石燃料燃烧、农业过程以及其他非燃烧过程。一次PM2.5和二次PM2.5均很重要，其中包括来自目前未受管制的前体污染物（如氨）所产生的PM2.5。我们认为，空气质量的改善可以通过持续削减传统上重要排放源的排放，以及通过针对相对重要性日益上升、且日益受到研究关注的排放源，采取新颖的减排策略来实现。此类变化有助于改善健康结果并实现其他环境目标。

title: Regional and county flows of particulate matter damage in the US
abstract: Despite several decades of declining emissions, the health costs of particulate matter (PM2.5) in the US remain substantial, with more than $1 trillion in annual damages. We analyze the inter-county impacts of PM2.5 for 2008, 2011, and 2014 and find that even though emissions from point sources have fallen over this period, the share of PM2.5 attributable to pollution transported across county and state boundaries is still considerable in many localities. Importantly, the benefits of reduced emissions are not uniformly distributed nationwide, with 26% of counties—concentrated in the South, Midwest, and Pacific Northwest—experiencing worsening health damages since 2008. Around 30% of all US counties receive 90% of their health damages from emissions in other counties, and these damage-importing counties also tend to have lower median incomes. Our results support continued state and federal cooperation to meet air quality standards and reduce the damages caused by PM2.5 from transported air pollution.
abstract_zh: 尽管排放量已下降数十年，美国PM2.5造成的健康损失仍然十分可观，每年的损害超过1万亿美元。我们分析了2008年、2011年和2014年PM2.5的县际影响，发现尽管在此期间点源排放有所下降，但在许多地区，由跨县和跨州边界传输的污染所造成的PM2.5占比仍然相当可观。重要的是，减排收益在全国范围内分布并不均衡：自2008年以来，26%的县（主要集中在南部、中西部和太平洋西北地区）的健康损害出现了恶化。全美约30%的县有90%的健康损害来自其他县的排放，而这些净承受损害的县往往中位收入也较低。我们的结果支持各州与联邦政府持续合作，以达到空气质量标准，并减少由跨境传输空气污染所造成的PM2.5损害。

title: An inter-comparison of the social costs of air quality from reduced-complexity models
abstract: Reliable estimates of externality costs—such as the costs arising from premature mortality due to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5)—are critical for policy analysis. To facilitate broader analysis, several datasets of the social costs of air quality have been produced by a set of reduced-complexity models (RCMs). It is much easier to use the tabulated marginal costs derived from RCMs than it is to run ‘state-of-the-science’ chemical transport models (CTMs). However, the differences between these datasets have not been systematically examined, leaving analysts with no guidance on how and when these differences matter. Here, we compare per-tonne marginal costs from ground level and elevated emission sources for each county in the United States for sulfur dioxide (SO2), nitrogen oxides (NOx), ammonia (NH3) and inert primary PM2.5 from three RCMs: Air Pollution Emission Experiments and Policy (AP2), Estimating Air pollution Social Impacts Using Regression (EASIUR) and the Intervention Model for Air Pollution (InMAP). National emission-weighted average damages vary among models by approximately 21%, 31%, 28% and 12% for inert primary PM2.5, SO2, NOx and NH3 emissions, respectively, for ground-level sources. For elevated sources, emission-weighted damages vary by approximately 42%, 26%, 42% and 20% for inert primary PM2.5, SO2, NOx and NH3 emissions, respectively. Despite fundamental structural differences, the three models predict marginal costs that are within the same order of magnitude. That different and independent methods have converged on similar results bolsters confidence in the RCMs. Policy analyzes of national-level air quality policies that sum over pollutants and geographical locations are often robust to these differences, although the differences may matter for more source- or location-specific analyzes. Overall, the loss of fidelity caused by using RCMs and their social cost datasets in place of CTMs is modest.
abstract_zh: 可靠的外部性成本估算（例如因暴露于细颗粒物（PM2.5）而导致的过早死亡所产生的成本）对政策分析至关重要。为便于更广泛的分析，一组简化复杂度模型（RCM）已生成了若干套空气质量社会成本数据集。与运行“最先进”的化学传输模型（CTM）相比，使用由RCM推导出的制表边际成本要容易得多。然而，这些数据集之间的差异尚未得到系统检验，分析人员因此无从得知这些差异如何以及何时会产生影响。本文比较了美国每个县来自地面及高架排放源的每吨边际成本，涉及二氧化硫（SO2）、氮氧化物（NOx）、氨（NH3）以及惰性一次PM2.5，所用模型为三种RCM：空气污染排放实验与政策模型（AP2）、利用回归估算空气污染社会影响模型（EASIUR）以及空气污染干预模型（InMAP）。对于地面排放源，三种模型给出的全国排放加权平均损害分别在惰性一次PM2.5、SO2、NOx和NH3排放上相差约21%、31%、28%和12%。对于高架排放源，排放加权损害在惰性一次PM2.5、SO2、NOx和NH3排放上的差异分别约为42%、26%、42%和20%。尽管三种模型在根本结构上存在差异，它们所预测的边际成本仍处于同一数量级。不同且相互独立的方法得出了相近的结果，这增强了对RCM的信心。对汇总各污染物及地理区域的全国性空气质量政策进行的政策分析，通常对这些差异具有稳健性，不过在针对特定排放源或特定地点的分析中，这些差异可能会产生影响。总体而言，用RCM及其社会成本数据集替代CTM所造成的精度损失是适度的。

title: Cumulative environmental and employment impacts of the shale gas boom
Distributional Effects of Air Pollution from Electric Vehicle Adoption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We examine distributional effects of changes in local air pollution from driving electric vehicles in the United States. An econometric model estimates power plant emissions and an integrated assessment model values damages in air pollution from electric and gasoline vehicles. Using data on currently registered electric vehicles, we find that people in census block groups with median income greater than about $65,000 receive positive environmental benefits while those below this threshold receive negative environmental benefits. On average, Asian and Hispanic residents receive positive environmental benefits, but white and black residents receive negative environmental benefits. In multivariate analyses with census region fixed effects, environmental benefits are positively correlated with income and urban measures and with Asian, black, and Hispanic block-group population shares. Created environmental benefits tend to be larger in states offering purchase subsidies. However, for these states, an increase in subsidy size is associated with a decrease in environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国驾驶电动汽车所引起的本地空气污染变化的分配效应。一个计量经济模型估算了发电厂排放，一个综合评估模型则对电动汽车和燃油汽车所造成的空气污染损害进行了估值。利用现有注册电动汽车的数据，我们发现，中位收入超过约6.5万美元的人口普查街区组居民获得了正的环境收益，而收入低于该门槛的居民则承受了负的环境收益。平均而言，亚裔和西班牙裔居民获得正的环境收益，而白人和黑人居民则承受负的环境收益。在包含人口普查区域固定效应的多变量分析中，环境收益与收入、城市化指标以及亚裔、黑人和西班牙裔的街区组人口占比呈正相关。在提供购车补贴的州，所创造的环境收益往往更大。然而，对于这些州而言，补贴金额的增加却与环境收益的减少相关。

title: Does Environmental Policy Affect Income Inequality? Evidence from the Clean Air Act
abstract: This paper quantifies the impact of environmental policy on income inequality. We focus on the Clean Air act and the National Ambient Air Quality standards for fine particulate matter and ozone. Using a matched difference-in-differences estimator, we find evidence that both standards increased inequality in market income and a measure of income that deducts per-capita air pollution damage from adjusted gross income. While pollution standards can reduce pollution levels and thus result in significant environmental benefits in aggregate, our findings suggest that these standards appear to distort the distribution of economic resources in complex, and at times unfortunate, ways.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了环境政策对收入不平等的影响。我们聚焦于《清洁空气法》以及针对细颗粒物和臭氧的国家环境空气质量标准。采用匹配双重差分估计量，我们发现有证据表明，这两项标准都加剧了市场收入的不平等，也加剧了一项收入指标的不平等，该指标是从调整后的总收入中扣除人均空气污染损害后得到的。尽管污染标准能够降低污染水平，从而在总体上带来显著的环境效益，但我们的研究结果表明，这些标准似乎以复杂、有时甚至不幸的方式扭曲了经济资源的分配。

title: External Costs of Transporting Petroleum Products: Evidence from Shipments of Crude Oil from North Dakota by Pipelines and Rail
abstract: Using data for crude oil transported out of North Dakota in 2014, this paper constructs new estimates of the air pollution, greenhouse gas, and spill and accident costs from long-distance movement of petroleum products by rail and pipelines. Our analysis has three main findings. First, air pollution and greenhouse gas costs are nearly twice as large for rail as for pipelines. Second, air pollution and greenhouse gas costs are much larger than estimates of spill and accidents costs. Third, air pollution and greenhouse gas costs of transporting fuel by rail and pipelines are one-fifth to one-tenth of the costs of combusting fuel in motor vehicles. These results suggest that the policy debate surrounding crude oil transportation may be putting too much relative weight on spills and accidents, while overlooking a far more serious external cost: air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2014年从北达科他州外运原油的数据，构建了通过铁路和管道长距离运输石油产品所产生的空气污染、温室气体、泄漏与事故成本的新估算。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。第一，铁路运输的空气污染和温室气体成本几乎是管道运输的两倍。第二，空气污染和温室气体成本远大于泄漏与事故成本的估算值。第三，通过铁路和管道运输燃料的空气污染和温室气体成本，仅为燃料在机动车中燃烧成本的五分之一至十分之一。这些结果表明，围绕原油运输的政策争论可能过于强调泄漏与事故的相对权重，而忽视了一项更为严重的外部成本：空气污染和温室气体排放。

title: Fine particulate matter damages and value added in the US economy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
abstract:
Emissions of most pollutants that result in fine particulate matter (PM
2.5
) formation have been decreasing in the United States. However, this trend has not been uniform across all sectors or regions of the economy. We use integrated assessment models (IAMs) to compute marginal damages for PM
2.5
-related emissions for each county in the contiguous United States and match location-specific emissions with these marginal damages to compute economy-wide gross external damage (GED) due to premature mortality. We note 4 key findings: First, economy-wide, GED has decreased by more than 20% from 2008 to 2014. Second, while much of the air pollution policies have focused to date on the electricity sector, damages from farms are now larger than those from utilities. Indeed, farms have become the largest contributor to air pollution damages from PM
2.5
-related emissions. Third, 4 sectors, comprising less than 20% of the national gross domestic product (GDP), are responsible for ∼75% of GED attributable to economic activities. Fourth, uncertainty in GED estimates tends to be high for sectors with predominantly ground-level emissions because these emissions are usually estimated and not measured. These findings suggest that policymakers should target further emissions reductions from such sectors, particularly in transportation and agriculture.
abstract_zh: 在美国，导致细颗粒物（PM2.5）生成的大多数污染物排放一直在下降。然而，这一趋势在经济各部门或各地区之间并不均衡。我们利用综合评估模型（IAM）计算了美国本土每个县PM2.5相关排放的边际损害，并将各地的排放与这些边际损害相匹配，以计算因过早死亡而产生的全经济总外部损害（GED）。我们得出四项主要发现。第一，全经济范围内，GED在2008年至2014年间下降了20%以上。第二，尽管迄今为止的大部分空气污染政策主要聚焦于电力部门，但农场造成的损害如今已超过公用事业部门。事实上，农场已成为PM2.5相关排放空气污染损害的最大贡献者。第三，4个部门合计占全国国内生产总值（GDP）不足20%，却造成了约75%的、可归因于经济活动的GED。第四，对于以地面排放为主的部门，GED估算的不确定性往往较高，因为这些排放通常是估算而非实测得出的。这些发现表明，政策制定者应当针对此类部门，特别是交通和农业部门，进一步减少排放。

title: Market-Based Emissions Regulation When Damages Vary across Sources: What Are the Gains from Differentiation?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Much of the air pollution currently regulated under U.S. emissions trading programs is non-uniformly mixed, meaning that health and environmental damages depend on the location and dispersion characteristics of the sources. Existing policy regimes ignore this fact. Emissions are penalized at a single permit price, regardless of the location of the source. In theory, differentiated policies can be designed to accommodate non-uniformly mixed pollution using emissions penalties that vary with emissions damages. Under perfect certainty, damage-based policy differentiation is unambiguously welfare improving. In the presence of uncertainty about damages and abatement costs, differentiated policies need not welfare dominate simpler, undifferentiated designs. Using rich data from a major U.S. emissions trading program, we estimate the welfare impacts of policy differentiation. Surprisingly, we find that differentiated emissions trading results in welfare loss as compared to the undifferentiated trading regime that was implemented. This result manifests because ex post realized abatement costs appear to have exceeded expectations. We further show that, in this context, a differentiated price-based policy welfare dominates the differentiated quantity-based alternative.
abstract_zh: 目前美国排放权交易计划所规制的大部分空气污染物并非均匀混合，这意味着健康和环境损害取决于排放源的位置和扩散特征。现行政策体制忽视了这一事实。无论排放源位于何处，排放都以统一的许可价格受到处罚。从理论上讲，可以设计差异化政策，采用随排放损害而变化的排放处罚，以适应非均匀混合的污染。在完全确定的情况下，基于损害的政策差异化无疑会改善福利。在损害和减排成本存在不确定性的情况下，差异化政策未必在福利上优于更简单的无差异化设计。利用美国一个大型排放权交易计划的丰富数据，我们估计了政策差异化的福利影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，与已实施的无差异化交易制度相比，差异化排放权交易导致了福利损失。出现这一结果的原因在于，事后实际实现的减排成本似乎超出了预期。我们进一步表明，在此背景下，差异化的价格型政策在福利上优于差异化的数量型替代方案。

title: Quantifying the social equity state of an energy system: environmental and labor market equity of the shale gas boom in Appalachia
abstract: A fundamental societal concern in energy system transitions is the distribution of benefits and costs across populations. A recent transition, the US shale gas boom, has dramatically altered the domestic energy outlook and global markets; however, the social equity implications have not been meaningfully assessed and accounted for in public and private decision making. In this study, we develop and demonstrate a systematic approach to quantify the multi-dimensional equity state of an energy system, with a focus on the shale gas boom in the Appalachian basin. We tailor variants of standard equity metrics as well as develop new empirical and analytical methods and metrics to assess spatial, temporal, income, and racial equity as it relates to air quality, climate change, and labor market impacts across the natural gas supply chain. We find moderate to high spatial inequities with respect to the distribution of production (Gini coefficient (η) = 0.93), consumption for electric power generation (η = 0.68), commercial, industrial, and residential end use (η = 0.72), job creation (η = 0.72), and air pollution-related deaths (η = 0.77), which are largely driven by geographically-fixed natural gas abundance and demand. Air quality impacts are also regressive, such that mortality risk induced by natural gas activity generally increases as income decreases; for example, mortality risk (m) (in units of premature mortality per 100 000 people) for the lowest income class (m = 0.22 in 2016) is higher (18%–31%) than for the highest income class (>$150 000; m = 0.27 in 2016). These risks are higher for white (m = 0.30 in 2016) than non-white (m = 0.16 in 2016) populations, which is largely a result of the demographics of rural communities within the vicinity of natural gas development. With respect to local labor market impacts within producing counties, we find marginal declines in income inequality (2.8% ± 1.0%) and poverty rates (9.9% ± 1.7%) during the boom, although household income increases for the wealthiest and decreases for the poorest. At a systems-level, there is an implied air quality-employment tradeoff of 3 (ε), which measure the sensitivity between different types of impacts, reveal that employment increases are sensitive to and coupled with increases in air and climate impacts (ε = 1.1 and ε = 1.3, respectively). The metrics applied here facilitate the evaluation and design of countervailing policies and systems that explicitly account for social inequities mediated through energy infrastructure, supply, and demand. For example, in future energy system transition, such equity metrics can be used to facilitate decisions related to the siting of low-carbon infrastructure such as transmission lines and wind turbines and the phase-out of fossil fuel infrastructure, as well as to demonstrate changes in distributional tradeoffs such as the decoupling of environmental and employment effects.
abstract_zh: 能源系统转型中的一个根本性社会关切，在于收益与成本在不同人群之间的分配。近期的一次转型——美国页岩气热潮——从根本上改变了国内能源前景和全球市场；然而，其社会公平影响尚未在公共和私人决策中得到实质性评估与考虑。在本研究中，我们提出并展示了一种系统性方法，用以量化能源系统的多维公平状态，并聚焦于阿巴拉契亚盆地的页岩气热潮。我们对标准公平指标进行了调整，并发展了新的实证与分析方法及指标，用以评估与天然气供应链相关的空气质量、气候变化和劳动力市场影响方面的空间、时间、收入和种族公平。我们发现，在生产分布（基尼系数（η）= 0.93）、用于发电的消费（η = 0.68）、商业、工业和居民终端使用（η = 0.72）、就业创造（η = 0.72）以及空气污染相关死亡（η = 0.77）方面存在中等至较高的空间不平等，这些不平等主要由地理上固定的天然气禀赋和需求所驱动。空气质量影响也具有累退性：天然气活动所引发的死亡风险通常随收入下降而上升。例如，最低收入群体的死亡风险（m）（以每10万人的过早死亡数计，2016年m = 0.22）比最高收入群体（收入超过15万美元；2016年m = 0.27）高出18%至31%。白人群体的风险（2016年m = 0.30）高于非白人群体（2016年m = 0.16），这在很大程度上是天然气开发周边农村社区人口结构的结果。就生产县内的地方劳动力市场影响而言，我们发现在热潮期间收入不平等（2.8% ± 1.0%）和贫困率（9.9% ± 1.7%）略有下降，尽管最富裕群体的家庭收入有所增加，而最贫穷群体的家庭收入有所减少。在系统层面，存在隐含的空气质量与就业之间的权衡，其参数为3（ε），用以衡量不同类型影响之间的敏感性。结果表明，就业增长对空气和气候影响的增加较为敏感，且二者耦合在一起（ε = 1.1和ε = 1.3）。本文所应用的指标有助于评估和设计能够明确考虑通过能源基础设施、供应和需求所产生的社会不平等的抵消性政策与系统。例如，在未来的能源系统转型中，此类公平指标可用于辅助输电线路和风力涡轮机等低碳基础设施的选址决策，以及化石燃料基础设施的逐步淘汰，并可用于展示诸如环境效应与就业效应脱钩等分配权衡的变化。

title: Hurricane Katrina Floods New Jersey: The Role of Information in the Market Response to Flood Risk
abstract: This study uses hedonic property models to explore how coastal real estate markets subject to heterogeneous information treatments respond to flood risk. We identify reactions to flood risk, distinctly from price effects due to flood damage, by examining non-local flooding events. Utilizing a difference-in-difference methodology, we test whether the coastal real estate market in New Jersey responds to several well-publicized hurricanes and tropical storms that did not strike the Atlantic seaboard. We find that homes in high flood risk zones situated in towns that participate in public flood awareness activities incur a 7 to 16 percent decrease in price after the non-local shock.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用特征价格模型，探讨在不同信息处理方式下，沿海房地产市场如何对洪水风险作出反应。通过考察非本地洪水事件，我们将对洪水风险的反应与洪水损害所导致的价格效应区分开来。利用双重差分方法，我们检验新泽西州沿海房地产市场是否会对若干广受报道、但并未袭击大西洋沿岸的飓风和热带风暴作出反应。我们发现，位于高洪水风险区、且所在城镇参与公共洪水宣传活动的住房，在非本地冲击之后价格下降了7%至16%。

title: Long-Run Environmental Accounting in the U.S. Economy
abstract: This paper estimates an augmented measure of national output inclusive of environmental pollution damage in the United States economy over a 60-year period. The paper reports two primary findings. First, air pollution intensity declined precipitously from the 1950s to the modern era. Air pollution damage comprised roughly 30 percent of output in the post WWII economy, declining to under 10 percent in 2016.Second, accounting for pollution damage significantly affects growth rates. Prior to the passage of the Clean Air Act in 1970, GDP outpaced Environmentally-Adjusted Value Added (EVA), defined as GDP less air pollution damage. Following passage of the Act, EVA grew more rapidly than GDP.Macroeconomic and environmental policies, as well as the business cycle, appreciably affect damages and EVA growth.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了美国经济在60年间包含环境污染损害的增广型国家产出指标。本文报告两项主要发现。第一，空气污染强度从20世纪50年代起急剧下降，直至现代。在二战后的经济中，空气污染损害约占产出的30%，到2016年已降至10%以下。第二，将污染损害纳入核算会显著影响增长率。在1970年《清洁空气法》通过之前，GDP的增长快于经调整的增加值（EVA），即GDP减去空气污染损害。该法通过之后，EVA的增长快于GDP。宏观经济与环境政策以及经济周期，均会对损害和EVA的增长产生显著影响。

title: Time Preference and the Great Depression: Evidence from Firewood Prices in Portland, Oregon
Effect of Model Spatial Resolution on Estimates of Fine Particulate Matter Exposure and Exposure Disparities in the United States
abstract: To the extent that pollution and population are spatially correlated, air quality modeling with coarse-resolution horizontal grids may systematically underpredict exposures and disparities in exposure among demographic groups (i.e., environmental injustice). We use InMAP, a reduced-complexity air pollution model, to quantify how estimates of year-2014 fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) exposure in the United States vary with model spatial resolution, for a variable-resolution grid. We test five grids, with population-weighted average grid cell edge lengths ranging from 5.9 to 69 km. We find that model-estimated PM 2.5 exposure, and exposure disparities among racial-ethnic groups, are lower with coarse grids than with fine grids: switching from our coarsest- to finest-resolution grid increases the calculated population-weighted average exposure by 27% (from 6.6 to 8.3 μg m –3 ) and causes the estimated difference in average exposure between minorities and whites to increase substantially (from 0.4 to 1.6 μg m –3 ). Across all grid resolutions, exposure disparities by race-ethnicity can be detected in every income category. Exposure disparities by income alone remain small relative to disparities by race-ethnicity, irrespective of resolution. These results demonstrate the importance of fine model spatial resolution for identifying and quantifying exposure disparity.
abstract_zh: 在污染与人口存在空间相关性的情况下，采用粗分辨率水平网格的空气质量模拟可能会系统性地低估暴露水平，以及不同人口群体之间的暴露差异（即环境不公）。我们使用简化复杂度空气污染模型InMAP，针对一种可变分辨率网格，量化了2014年美国细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露估计值如何随模型空间分辨率而变化。我们测试了五种网格，其人口加权平均网格单元边长介于5.9至69公里之间。我们发现，模型估算的PM2.5暴露量以及不同种族-族裔群体之间的暴露差异，在粗网格下低于细网格：从最粗分辨率网格切换到最细分辨率网格，会使计算得出的人口加权平均暴露量增加27%（从6.6增至8.3 μg m⁻³），并使少数族裔与白人之间平均暴露差异显著扩大（从0.4增至1.6 μg m⁻³）。在所有网格分辨率下，都能在每个收入类别中检测到按种族-族裔划分的暴露差异。无论分辨率如何，仅按收入划分的暴露差异相对于按种族-族裔划分的差异都很小。这些结果表明，精细的模型空间分辨率对于识别和量化暴露差异至关重要。

title: Environmental Benefit-Cost Analysis and the National Accounts
abstract: This paper demonstrates a new connection between benefit-cost analysis (BCA) and the national income and product accounts. The article computes an augmented measure of output, which is defined as gross domestic product (GDP) less environmental pollution damage. Environmental policy BCA is incorporated directly into the adjusted measure of output in two ways. In a particular time period, damages from pollution emissions are deducted from market GDP in a standard with-and-without policy comparison. Second, secular changes in damages, output (GDP), and correspondingly, in the adjusted measure of output are employed to estimate augmented rates of growth. Comparison to a no-policy counterfactual then yields the effect of the policy on the augmented measure of environmentally adjusted value added (EVA) growth. The empirical results suggest that, in the 30 states that adopted flue-gas desulfurization (FGD) technology between 2005 and 2011, augmented output grew 0.12% more quickly than in a no-scrub counterfactual. Augmented output growth in four states was at least 0.20% more rapid because of the installation of scrubbers. The paper reports that benefits-per-capita from FGD were mildly progressive and that counties with relatively large African American populations incur large benefits from FGD installation.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了成本效益分析（BCA）与国民收入和产品账户之间的一种新联系。本文计算了一种增广产出指标，其定义为国内生产总值（GDP）减去环境污染损害。环境政策的成本效益分析以两种方式直接纳入经调整的产出指标。其一，在特定时期，在标准的有政策与无政策比较中，从市场GDP中扣除污染排放所造成的损害。其二，利用损害、产出（GDP）以及经调整产出指标的长期变化，估算增广增长率。与无政策的反事实情形相比，即可得出政策对环境调整增加值（EVA）增长的影响。实证结果表明，在2005年至2011年间采用烟气脱硫（FGD）技术的30个州中，增广产出的增长速度比无脱硫装置的反事实情形快0.12%。在四个州中，由于安装了脱硫装置，增广产出的增长至少快0.20%。本文报告称，FGD带来的人均效益具有一定的累进性，且非裔美国人人口比例较高的县从FGD的安装中获得了大量效益。

title: The distribution of income is worse than you think: Including pollution impacts into measures of income inequality
abstract: This paper calculates the distribution of an adjusted measure of income that deducts damages due to exposure to air pollution from reported market income in the United States from 2011 to 2014.The Gini coefficient for this measure of adjusted income is 0.682 in 2011, as compared to 0.482 for market income. Further, the difference between adjusted income for white and Hispanics is smaller than expected. However, the gap in augmented income between whites and African-Americans is widening.
