title: What Forces Dictate the Design of Pollution Monitoring Networks?
abstract: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (USEPA) maintains networks of pollution monitors for two basic purposes: to check and enforce the attainment of national ambient air quality standards (NAAQS) and to provide useful data for studying pollution and its effects. These purposes imply conflicting criteria for the locations of a limited number of monitors. To check the attainment of standards, monitors are placed where pollution levels are highest. Monitors are not required where standards have always been met and there are no new pollution sources. To provide useful data for studying pollution and its effects, monitors are placed to observe outcomes under a variety of pollution levels. This study asks the following questions. What factors affect when a monitor is retired from the network? What drives the decision to add a new site? What causes year-to-year changes in the number of monitors? We tackle these questions with a particular focus on the role of regulatory compliance and pollution levels in the context of monitors for tropospheric ozone (O3). Using a panel dataset of monitors in the contiguous US spanning the years 1993 to 2011, we find that peak O3 readings in the prior period are significantly associated with the regulator’s decision of whether to add or to drop a monitor in the following period. While compliance with the NAAQS for O3 is not consistently associated with network composition, compliance with the PM2.5 NAAQS does appear to affect changes to the network.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署（USEPA）维护着污染监测网络，其基本目的有两个：检查并执行国家环境空气质量标准（NAAQS）的达标情况，以及提供有助于研究污染及其影响的有用数据。这两个目的对数量有限的监测站点的选址提出了相互冲突的标准。为检查标准的达标情况，监测站点应设在污染水平最高的地方。在标准始终达标且没有新增污染源的地区，则不要求设置监测站点。为提供有助于研究污染及其影响的有用数据，监测站点则应设在能够观测各种污染水平下结果的地方。本研究提出以下问题：哪些因素决定监测站点何时从网络中撤除？哪些因素推动新增站点的决策？哪些因素导致监测站点数量逐年变化？我们以对流层臭氧（O3）监测站点为背景，特别关注监管合规和污染水平的作用，来探讨这些问题。利用1993年至2011年美国本土监测站点的面板数据，我们发现，前一期的臭氧峰值读数与监管部门在下一期是否增设或撤除监测站点的决策显著相关。尽管臭氧国家环境空气质量标准的合规情况与监测网络的构成并无稳定的关联，但PM2.5国家环境空气质量标准的合规情况似乎确实影响了网络的变化。

title: Livestreaming Pollution: A New Form of Public Disclosure and a Catalyst for Citizen Engagement?
abstract: Most environmental policy assumes the form of standards and enforcement. Scarce public budgets motivate the use of disclosure laws. This study explores a new form of pollution disclosure: real-time visual evidence of emissions provided on a free, public website. The paper tests whether the disclosure of visual evidence of emissions affects the nature and frequency of phone calls to the local air quality regulator. First, we test whether the presence of the camera affects the frequency of calls to the local air quality regulator about the facility monitored by the camera. Second, we test the relationship between the camera being active and the number of complaints about facilities other than the plant recorded by the camera. Our empirical results suggest that the camera did not affect the frequency of calls to the regulator about the monitored facility. However, the count of complaints pertaining to another prominent industrial polluter in the area, steel manufacturing plants, is positively associated with the camera being active. We propose two behavioral reasons for this finding: the prior knowledge hypothesis and affect heuristics. This study argues that visual evidence is a feasible approach to environmental oversight even during periods with diminished regulatory capacity.
abstract_zh: 大多数环境政策都采取标准与执法的形式。公共预算有限，促使人们采用信息披露法规。本研究探讨了一种新的污染信息披露形式：通过免费的公共网站提供排放的实时视觉证据。本文检验了排放视觉证据的披露是否会影响致电当地空气质量监管机构的频率与性质。首先，我们检验摄像头的存在是否会影响关于摄像头所监控工厂的来电频率。其次，我们检验摄像头处于工作状态与针对摄像头所记录工厂以外的其他设施的投诉数量之间的关系。我们的实证结果表明，摄像头并未影响关于被监控设施的监管来电频率。然而，与该地区另一重要工业污染源——钢铁制造厂相关的投诉数量，与摄像头处于工作状态呈正相关。我们提出两种行为学解释来说明这一发现：先验知识假说和情感启发式。本研究认为，即使在监管能力减弱的时期，视觉证据也是一种可行的环境监督方式。

title: Air and Water: Integrated Assessment Models for Multiple Media
abstract: Economics has long provided the theoretical framework for efficient pollution management. Efficiency requires equating marginal damages of pollution emissions to their marginal control costs. Recent advances in integrated assessment models (IAMs) highlight the importance of estimating and incorporating marginal damages into pollution policy design. Concurrently, this work has also advanced pollution management at the macroeconomic level. Marginal damages play a critical role in tracking total damages of pollution through national accounts. This article reviews these recent advances and discusses the status of IAMs for air and water pollution. Several exciting research challenges for future IAMs are discussed.
abstract_zh: 经济学长期以来为高效的污染管理提供了理论框架。效率要求污染排放的边际损害与其边际控制成本相等。综合评估模型（IAM）的最新进展凸显了估计并将边际损害纳入污染政策设计的重要性。与此同时，这项工作也推动了宏观经济层面的污染管理。边际损害在通过国民账户追踪污染总损害方面发挥着关键作用。本文回顾了这些最新进展，并讨论了空气与水污染综合评估模型的现状。文中还讨论了未来综合评估模型面临的若干令人振奋的研究挑战。

title: Does environmental policy affect scaling laws between population and pollution? Evidence from American metropolitan areas
abstract: Modern cities are engines of production, innovation, and growth. However, urbanization also increases both local and global pollution from household consumption and firms' production. Do emissions change proportionately to city size or does pollution tend to outpace or lag urbanization? Do emissions scale differently with population versus economic growth or are emissions, population, and economic growth inextricably linked? How are the scaling relationships between emissions, population, and economic growth affected by environmental regulation? This paper examines the link between urbanization, economic growth and pollution using data from Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs) in the United States between 1999 and 2011. We find that the emissions of local air pollution in these MSAs scale according to a ¾ power law with both population size and gross domestic product (GDP). However, the monetary damages from these local emissions scale linearly with both population and GDP. Counties that have previously been out of attainment with the local air quality standards set by the Clean Air Act show an entirely different relationship: local emissions scale according to the square root of population, while the monetary damages from local air pollution follow a 2/3rds power law with population. Counties out of attainment are subject to more stringent emission controls; we argue based on this that enforcement of the Clean Air Act induces sublinear scaling between emissions, damages, and city size. In contrast, we find that metropolitan GDP scales super-linearly with population in all MSAs regardless of attainment status. Summarizing, our findings suggest that environmental policy limits the adverse effects of urbanization without interfering with the productivity benefits that manifest in cities.
abstract_zh: 现代城市是生产、创新和增长的引擎。然而，城市化也会增加家庭消费和企业生产所造成的本地及全球污染。排放量是否与城市规模成比例变化，还是污染的增长快于或慢于城市化？排放与人口增长和经济增长之间的标度关系是否不同，或者排放、人口与经济增长是否密不可分？环境监管如何影响排放、人口与经济增长之间的标度关系？本文利用1999年至2011年美国大都市统计区（MSA）的数据，考察了城市化、经济增长与污染之间的联系。我们发现，这些大都市统计区的本地空气污染排放与人口规模和国内生产总值（GDP）均服从3/4幂律。然而，这些本地排放所造成的货币损害则与人口和GDP均呈线性关系。此前未达到《清洁空气法》所设地方空气质量标准的县，则呈现出截然不同的关系：本地排放与人口的平方根成比例，而本地空气污染的货币损害则随人口呈2/3次幂律变化。未达标的县受到更为严格的排放控制；基于此，我们认为《清洁空气法》的执行促成了排放、损害与城市规模之间的次线性标度关系。相比之下，无论是否达标，我们发现所有大都市统计区的大都市GDP均随人口呈超线性增长。总之，我们的研究结果表明，环境政策能够限制城市化的不利影响，同时又不妨碍城市中所体现的生产率优势。

title: Environmental Accounting
abstract: While metrics such as gross domestic product (GDP) constitute important means to gauge the value of production, it is widely recognized that indices that focus exclusively on market production are incomplete. Omitted environmental assets include (i) those that have the capacity to act as a source of valuable inputs to production such as timber, subsurface minerals, or fisheries; and (ii) media that serve as a sink for anthropogenic residuals such as air, water, or soil. The human health impacts depend crucially on two parameters in the integrated asset models (IAMs): the effect that exposures to fine particles have on adult mortality rates and the value attributed to small changes in mortality risk. This essay focuses on recent research that augments standard measures of output to include damages from air and greenhouse gas pollution into national output.
abstract_zh: 尽管国内生产总值（GDP）等指标是衡量生产价值的重要手段，但人们普遍认识到，仅关注市场生产的指标是不完整的。被遗漏的环境资产包括：（i）能够作为生产中有价值投入来源的资产，如木材、地下矿产或渔业资源；以及（ii）作为人为残余物汇的媒介，如空气、水或土壤。人类健康影响主要取决于综合资产模型（IAM）中的两个参数：细颗粒物暴露对成人死亡率的影响，以及对死亡风险微小变化所赋予的价值。本文聚焦于近期的研究，这些研究将空气和温室气体污染的损害纳入国民产出，从而扩充了标准的产出衡量指标。

title: Air pollution emissions and damages from energy production in the US: 2002-2011
Are There Environmental Benefits from Driving Electric Vehicles? The Importance of Local Factors
Damages and Expected Deaths Due to Excess NOX Emissions from 2009 to 2015 Volkswagen Diesel Vehicles
abstract: We estimate the damages and expected deaths in the United States due to excess emissions of NOx from 2009 to 2015 Volkswagen diesel vehicles. Using data on vehicle registrations and a model of pollution transport and valuation, we estimate excess damages of $430 million and 46 excess expected deaths. Accounting for uncertainty about emissions gives a range for damages from $350 million to $500 million, and a range for excess expected deaths from 40 to 52. Our estimates incorporate significant local heterogeneity: for example, Minneapolis has the highest damages despite having fewer noncompliant vehicles than 13 other cities. Our estimated damages greatly exceed possible benefits from reduced CO2 emissions due to increased fuel economy.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了2009年至2015年间，大众柴油车超额排放氮氧化物（NOx）在美国造成的损害与预期死亡人数。利用车辆注册数据以及污染物传输与估值模型，我们估计超额损害为4.3亿美元，超额预期死亡人数为46人。考虑排放的不确定性后，损害的范围为3.5亿至5亿美元，超额预期死亡人数的范围为40至52人。我们的估算纳入了显著的地方异质性：例如，明尼阿波利斯的损害最高，尽管其不合规车辆数量少于其他13个城市。我们估算的损害大大超过了因提高燃油经济性而减少的CO2排放可能带来的效益。

title: On the divergence between fuel and service prices: The importance of technological change and diffusion in an American frontier economy
Power Laws and Air Pollution
An Input-Output Model of the U.S. Economy with Pollution Externality
abstract: Input-output (I-O) analysis represents the flows of goods and services within the market. Environmentally-extended I-O (EEIO) models include flows of both pollution and consumption of resources and energy. The present paper proposes a conceptual structure for EEIO accounts that builds on the work of Leontief (1970) and Hendrickson, Lave, and Matthews (2006), and then estimates empirical EEIO accounts for the U.S. economy in 1999 and 2011.The empirical accounts provide the first complete characterization of the air pollution damage flows throughout the U.S. economy. Pollution intensity fell from 7 percent of value-added in 1999 to 2 percent in 2011.The utility sector exhibits the highest ratio of pollution damage from value-added production to supply chain damage; this ratio was 22 in 1999 and 54 in 2011.About one-half of all damage comes from intermediate demand, one-third from household consumption, and about 7 percent each from fixed investment and government use of commodities. In both 1999 and 2011, damages would have been about 7 percent higher had all imports been made domestically. The damages from exported goods nearly doubled from 5 percent to almost 10 percent of total pollution damage.
abstract_zh: 投入产出（I-O）分析刻画了市场内部商品和服务的流动。环境扩展投入产出（EEIO）模型则同时包含污染物以及资源和能源消耗的流动。本文提出了EEIO账户的概念框架，该框架建立在Leontief（1970）以及Hendrickson、Lave和Matthews（2006）工作的基础之上，并进而估算了1999年和2011年美国经济的实证EEIO账户。这些实证账户首次完整刻画了美国整个经济中空气污染损害的流动。污染强度从1999年占增加值的7%下降到2011年的2%。公用事业部门的生产性污染损害与供应链损害之比最高；该比值在1999年为22，在2011年为54。约一半的损害来自中间需求，三分之一来自家庭消费，固定投资和政府商品使用各约占7%。在1999年和2011年，如果所有进口商品都在国内生产，损害将分别高出约7%。出口商品所造成的损害几乎翻了一番，从占污染损害总额的5%增至近10%。

title: Air Pollution Damages from Offshore Energy Production
abstract: This analysis uses an integrated assessment model to link emissions from offshore oil and gas platforms in the Gulf of Mexico to impacts in the continental U.S. The analysis employs emission and production data for rigs located in the Gulf of Mexico to estimate the air pollution damages for the years 2000, 2005, and 2008. For platforms in the western Gulf of Mexico, extraction yields damage due to air pollution that average between $0.31 and $0.75 per unit of oil extracted. For platforms in the central Gulf of Mexico, damage due to air pollution averages between $0.26 and $0.57 per unit of oil extracted. The distribution of marginal social costs is right-skewed; the paper finds that in 2008 115 platforms produce damages in excess of $12.80 per barrel of oil. Optimal management of the air pollution emissions from platforms in the Gulf must recognize this spatial heterogeneity in damages.
abstract_zh: 本分析利用综合评估模型，将墨西哥湾海上石油和天然气平台的排放与美国大陆的影响联系起来。分析利用墨西哥湾钻井平台的排放与产量数据，估算了2000年、2005年和2008年的空气污染损害。对于墨西哥湾西部的平台，石油开采所产生的空气污染损害平均为每单位石油0.31至0.75美元。对于墨西哥湾中部的平台，空气污染损害平均为每单位石油0.26至0.57美元。边际社会成本的分布呈右偏态；本文发现，2008年有115个平台所产生的损害超过每桶石油12.80美元。墨西哥湾平台空气污染排放的最优管理必须认识到损害的这种空间异质性。

title: ECONOMICS Boosting GDP growth by accounting for the environment
Using index numbers for deflation in environmental accounting
abstract: Systematic trends in the general price level of goods and services are the subject of extensive measurement and significant interest among researchers, policy makers and the general public. Dynamic price measurement is also important in environmental accounting in that real measures of augmented output are required to draw inferences on sustainability. This paper computes price indices for emissions of five air pollutants in the United States. Using marginal damages, the paper computes Paasche, Laspeyres, Fisher and Tornquist index numbers for five air pollutants spanning the period 1999–2008 for use in computing real environmental accounts. Evidence of time series heterogeneity in the marginal damages is detected: marginal damages for nitrogen oxides increase by a factor of two and marginal damages for NH3decrease by one-half. The analysis finds that nominal gross damages from air pollution in the United States decrease by 40 per cent between 1999 and 2008.
abstract_zh: 商品和服务的总体价格水平的系统性趋势，是研究人员、政策制定者和公众广泛测量并高度关注的对象。动态价格测量在环境核算中也很重要，因为需要以实际衡量的增广产出来推断可持续性。本文计算了美国五种空气污染物排放的价格指数。利用边际损害，本文计算了1999年至2008年期间五种空气污染物的Paasche、Laspeyres、Fisher和Tornquist指数，以用于计算实际环境账户。我们发现边际损害存在时间序列异质性：氮氧化物的边际损害增加了一倍，而NH3的边际损害则减少了一半。分析发现，1999年至2008年间，美国空气污染的名义总损害下降了40%。

title: PM2.5 co-benefits of climate change legislation part 1: California’s AB 32
abstract: The Scoping Plan for compliance with California Assembly Bill 32 (Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006; AB 32) proposes a substantial reduction in 2020 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from all economic sectors through energy efficiency, renewable energy, and other technological measures. Most of the AB 32 Scoping Plan measures will simultaneously reduce emissions of traditional criteria pollutants along with GHGs leading to a co-benefit of improved air quality in California. The present study quantifies the airborne particulate matter (PM2.5) co-benefits of AB 32 by comparing future air quality under a Business as Usual (BAU) scenario (without AB 32) to AB 32 implementation by sector. AB 32 measures were divided into five levels defined by sector as follows: 1) industrial sources, 2) electric utility and natural gas sources, 3) agricultural sources, 4) on-road mobile sources and 5) other mobile sources. Air quality throughout California was simulated using the UCD source-oriented air quality model during 12 days of severe air pollution and over 108 days of typical meteorology representing an annual average period in the year 2030 (10 years after the AB 32 adoption deadline). The net effect of all AB 32 measures reduced statewide primary PM and NOx emissions by ~1 % and ~15 %, respectively. Air quality simulations predict that these emissions reductions lower population-weighted PM2.5 concentrations by ~6 % for California. The South Coast Air Basin (SoCAB) experienced the greatest reductions in PM2.5 concentrations due to the AB 32 transportation measures while the San Joaquin Valley (SJV) experiences the smallest reductions or even slight increases in PM2.5 concentrations due to the AB 32 measures that called for increased use of dairy biogas for electricity generation. The ~6 % reduction in PM2.5 exposure associated with AB 32 predicted in the current study reduced air pollution mortality in California by 6.2 %, avoiding 880 (560–1100) premature deaths per year for the conditions in 2030. The monetary benefit from this avoided mortality was estimated at $5.4B/yr with a weighted average benefit per tonne of $35 k/tonne ($23 k/tonne–$45 k/tonne) of PM, NOx, SOx, and NH3 emissions reduction.
abstract_zh: 加利福尼亚州第32号议会法案（《2006年全球变暖解决方案法》；AB 32）合规的《规划方案》提出，到2020年，通过能效提升、可再生能源及其他技术措施，使所有经济部门的温室气体（GHG）排放大幅减少。AB 32《规划方案》的大部分措施在减少温室气体的同时，也将同步减少传统标准污染物的排放，从而为加州带来空气质量改善的协同效益。本研究通过比较一切照旧（BAU）情景（无AB 32）与按部门实施AB 32的未来空气质量，量化了AB 32的细颗粒物（PM2.5）协同效益。AB 32措施按部门划分为五个层级：1）工业排放源，2）电力公用事业和天然气排放源，3）农业排放源，4）道路移动源，以及5）其他移动源。我们使用UCD源导向空气质量模型，模拟了加州的空气质量，模拟时段包括12天的严重空气污染期以及代表2030年（即AB 32通过截止期限后10年）年均情况的108天典型气象条件。AB 32所有措施的净效应使全州一次PM和NOx排放分别减少约1%和约15%。空气质量模拟预测，这些排放削减使加州的人口加权PM2.5浓度降低约6%。南海岸空气盆地（SoCAB）因AB 32的交通措施而经历了PM2.5浓度的最大降幅，而圣华金河谷（SJV）则由于AB 32中鼓励增加使用奶牛沼气发电的措施，PM2.5浓度的降幅最小，甚至略有上升。本研究预测，AB 32所带来的PM2.5暴露约6%的减少，使加州的空气污染死亡率降低了6.2%，即在2030年的条件下，每年避免880例（560至1100例）过早死亡。这种避免死亡所带来的货币效益估计为每年54亿美元，PM、NOx、SOx和NH3减排的加权平均效益为每吨35千美元（每吨23千美元至45千美元）。

title: Global Air Quality and Health Co-benefits of Mitigating Near-Term Climate Change through Methane and Black Carbon Emission Controls
abstract:
Background: Tropospheric ozone and black carbon (BC), a component of fine particulate matter (PM ≤ 2.5 µm in aerodynamic diameter; PM2.5), are associated with premature mortality and they disrupt global and regional climate.
Objectives: We examined the air quality and health benefits of 14 specific emission control measures targeting BC and methane, an ozone precursor, that were selected because of their potential to reduce the rate of climate change over the next 20–40 years.
Methods: We simulated the impacts of mitigation measures on outdoor concentrations of PM2.5 and ozone using two composition-climate models, and calculated associated changes in premature PM2.5- and ozone-related deaths using epidemiologically derived concentration–response functions.
Results: We estimated that, for PM2.5 and ozone, respectively, fully implementing these measures could reduce global population-weighted average surface concentrations by 23–34% and 7–17% and avoid 0.6–4.4 and 0.04–0.52 million annual premature deaths globally in 2030. More than 80% of the health benefits are estimated to occur in Asia. We estimated that BC mitigation measures would achieve approximately 98% of the deaths that would be avoided if all BC and methane mitigation measures were implemented, due to reduced BC and associated reductions of nonmethane ozone precursor and organic carbon emissions as well as stronger mortality relationships for PM2.5 relative to ozone. Although subject to large uncertainty, these estimates and conclusions are not strongly dependent on assumptions for the concentration–response function.
Conclusions: In addition to climate benefits, our findings indicate that the methane and BC emission control measures would have substantial co-benefits for air quality and public health worldwide, potentially reversing trends of increasing air pollution concentrations and mortality in Africa and South, West, and Central Asia. These projected benefits are independent of carbon dioxide mitigation measures. Benefits of BC measures are underestimated because we did not account for benefits from reduced indoor exposures and because outdoor exposure estimates were limited by model spatial resolution.
abstract_zh: 背景：对流层臭氧和黑碳（BC）（黑碳是细颗粒物（空气动力学直径≤2.5 µm；PM2.5）的组成部分）与过早死亡相关，并且它们扰乱全球和区域气候。目标：我们考察了14项针对黑碳和甲烷（一种臭氧前体）的具体排放控制措施的空气质量与健康效益，这些措施之所以被选中，是因为它们具有在未来20至40年内减缓气候变化速度的潜力。方法：我们使用两个成分-气候模型模拟了减排措施对PM2.5和臭氧室外浓度的影响，并利用流行病学推导的浓度-反应函数计算了由此导致的过早PM2.5和臭氧相关死亡的变化。结果：我们估计，就PM2.5和臭氧而言，全面实施这些措施可分别使全球人口加权平均地表浓度降低23%至34%和7%至17%，并于2030年在全球范围内每年避免60万至440万例和4万至52万例过早死亡。超过80%的健康效益预计发生在亚洲。我们估计，由于黑碳减少以及相关的非甲烷臭氧前体和有机碳排放的减少，以及PM2.5相对于臭氧具有更强的死亡率关系，黑碳减排措施将实现约98%的死亡避免量，而若实施全部黑碳和甲烷减排措施，则可避免的死亡数量即为此。尽管存在较大的不确定性，这些估计和结论并不强烈依赖于浓度-反应函数的假设。结论：除了气候效益外，我们的研究结果表明，甲烷和黑碳排放控制措施将对全球空气质量和公共健康产生实质性的协同效益，有可能扭转非洲以及南亚、西亚和中亚地区空气污染浓度和死亡率上升的趋势。这些预计的效益独立于二氧化碳减排措施。由于我们未考虑减少室内暴露所带来的效益，且室外暴露估计受模型空间分辨率的限制，黑碳措施的效益被低估了。

title: Simultaneously Mitigating Near-Term Climate Change and Improving Human Health and Food Security
abstract:
Tropospheric ozone can be dangerous to human health, can be harmful to vegetation, and is a major contributor to climate warming. Black carbon also has significant negative effects on health and air quality and causes warming of the atmosphere.
Shindell
et al.
(p.
183
) present results of an analysis of emissions, atmospheric processes, and impacts for each of these pollutants. Seven measures were identified that, if rapidly implemented, would significantly reduce global warming over the next 50 years, with the potential to prevent millions of deaths worldwide from outdoor air pollution. Furthermore, some crop yields could be improved by decreasing agricultural damage. Most of the measures thus appear to have economic benefits well above the cost of their implementation.
abstract_zh: 对流层臭氧可能危害人体健康，可能损害植被，并且是导致气候变暖的主要因素之一。黑碳同样对健康和空气质量产生显著的负面影响，并导致大气变暖。Shindell等人（第183页）对这些污染物的排放、大气过程和影响进行了分析并给出了结果。研究确定了七项措施，如果迅速实施，将显著减缓未来50年的全球变暖，并有可能防止全球数百万人死于室外空气污染。此外，减少农业损害可以提高部分作物的产量。因此，这些措施大多似乎具有远超其实施成本的经济效益。

title: The design of optimal climate policy with air pollution co-benefits
Using Marginal Damages in Environmental Policy A Study of Air Pollution in the United States
Climate, health, agricultural and economic impacts of tighter vehicle-emission standards
Environmental Accounting for Pollution in the United States Economy
abstract: This study presents a framework to include environmental externalities into a system of national accounts. The paper estimates the air pollution damages for each industry in the United States. An integrated-assessment model quantifies the marginal damages of air pollution emissions for the US which are multiplied times the quantity of emissions by industry to compute gross damages. Solid waste combustion, sewage treatment, stone quarrying, marinas, and oil and coal-fired power plants have air pollution damages larger than their value added. The largest industrial contributor to external costs is coal-fired electric generation, whose damages range from 0.8 to 5.6 times value added. (JEL E01, L94, Q53, Q56)
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一个将环境外部性纳入国民账户体系的框架。本文估算了美国各行业的空气污染损害。一个综合评估模型量化了美国空气污染排放的边际损害，并将其乘以各行业的排放量，以计算总损害。固体废物焚烧、污水处理、石料开采、码头以及燃油和燃煤发电厂的空气污染损害，均超过其增加值。外部成本最大的工业贡献者是燃煤发电，其损害为增加值的0.8至5.6倍。（JEL E01, L94, Q53, Q56）

title: Linking Policy to Statistical Uncertainty in Air Pollution Damages
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy, The
abstract: This study uses Monte Carlo analysis to characterize the uncertainty associated with per-ton damage estimates for 565 electric generating units (EGUs) in the contiguous United States (U.S.) This analysis focuses on damage estimates produced by an Integrated Assessment Model (IAM) for emissions of five local air pollutants: sulfur dioxide (SO2), nitrogen oxides (NOx), volatile organic compounds (VOCs), ammonia (NH3), and fine particulate matter (PM2.5). For each power plant and pollutant, the Monte Carlo procedure yields an empirical distribution for the damage per ton, or marginal damage. The paper links uncertainty in marginal damages to air pollution policy in two ways. First, the paper characterizes uncertainty in the magnitude of the marginal damages which is relevant to policymakers in determining the stringency of pollution controls. Second, the paper explores uncertainty in the relative damages across power plants. Relative damages are important if policymakers elect to design efficient regulations that vary in stringency according to where emissions are released. The empirical section of the paper finds that the marginal damage distributions are positively skewed and they are more variable for sources in urban areas than rural locations. The paper finds that uncertainty in three input parameters has the greatest impact on uncertainty in the magnitude of damages: the adult mortality dose-response parameter, the mortality valuation parameter, and air quality modeling. The analysis also finds that for each pollutant except for NOx only uncertainty in air quality modeling impacts efficient trading ratios calibrated to each firm's marginal damages.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用蒙特卡洛分析，刻画了美国本土565台发电机组（EGU）每吨损害估计值所伴随的不确定性。本分析聚焦于综合评估模型（IAM）对五种本地空气污染物排放所得出的损害估计：二氧化硫（SO2）、氮氧化物（NOx）、挥发性有机化合物（VOC）、氨（NH3）以及细颗粒物（PM2.5）。对于每个发电厂和每种污染物，蒙特卡洛程序得出了每吨损害（即边际损害）的经验分布。本文以两种方式将边际损害的不确定性与空气污染政策联系起来。首先，本文刻画了边际损害量级的不确定性，这对于决定污染控制力度的政策制定者而言至关重要。其次，本文探讨了各发电厂之间相对损害的不确定性。若政策制定者选择设计根据排放地点而在控制力度上有所区别的有效监管，则相对损害就十分重要。实证部分发现，边际损害分布呈正偏态，且城市地区排放源的损害比农村地区更具变异性。本文发现，三个输入参数的不确定性对损害量级的不确定性影响最大：成人死亡率剂量-反应参数、死亡率估值参数以及空气质量模拟。分析还发现，除NOx外，对于其他每种污染物，只有空气质量模拟的不确定性会影响根据每家企业边际损害校准的有效交易比率。

title: Efficient Pollution Regulation: Getting the Prices Right
abstract: This paper argues for efficient environmental regulations that equate the marginal damage of pollution to marginal abatement costs across space. The paper estimates the source-specific marginal damages of air pollution and calculates the welfare gain from making the current sulfur dioxide allowance trading program for power plants more efficient. The savings from using trading ratios based on marginal damages are between $310 and $940 million per year. The potential savings from setting aggregate emissions efficiently and from including more sources of air pollution are many times higher. (JEL H23, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文主张，有效的环境监管应使污染的边际损害在空间上与边际减排成本相等。本文估算了各排放源的空气污染边际损害，并计算了使当前发电厂二氧化硫排放配额交易计划更有效率所带来的福利增益。采用基于边际损害的交易比率所节省的成本，每年在3.1亿至9.4亿美元之间。若有效设定总排放量并纳入更多空气污染源，所能节省的潜在成本则要高出许多倍。（JEL H23, Q53, Q58）

title: Regulating NOx and SO2 Emissions in Atlanta
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy, The
abstract: Through a series of experiments, we measure the marginal damage of emissions near Atlanta using a sophisticated integrated assessment model. The marginal damages of sulfur dioxide (SO2) are driven by proximity to downtown Atlanta; emissions produced closer to the city lead to higher exposures and therefore damages. The spatial pattern in damages from nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions are more complex because of the powerful role of atmospheric chemistry. NOx emissions from ground-level sources in downtown Atlanta reduce aggregate exposures to both the tropospheric ozone as well as small particulates. In contrast, NOx discharges in suburban or rural areas lead to higher exposures and damages from both pollutants. These findings raise questions about the current policy of treating all NOx and SOx emissions as though they are alike.
abstract_zh: 通过一系列实验，我们利用一个精细的综合评估模型，测量了亚特兰大附近排放的边际损害。二氧化硫（SO2）的边际损害取决于其与亚特兰大市中心的距离：离城市越近的排放，会导致越高的暴露水平，因而损害也越大。氮氧化物（NOx）排放损害的空间格局则更为复杂，这是由于大气化学的强大作用。亚特兰大市中心地面排放源的NOx排放，会降低对对流层臭氧和细颗粒物的总体暴露。与此相反，郊区或农村地区的NOx排放则会导致两种污染物的暴露和损害增加。这些发现对当前将所有NOx和SOx排放视为同质的政策提出了质疑。

title: Using air quality modeling to study source-receptor relationships between nitrogen oxides emissions and ozone exposures over the United States
Using hedonic property models to value public water bodies: An analysis of specification issues
abstract: The hedonic literature has established that public water bodies provide external benefits that are reflected in the value of nearby residential real estate. The literature has employed several approaches to quantify these nonmarket services. With a residential hedonic model, this paper tests whether model specification affects resource valuation using an actively managed reservoir in Indiana and a passively managed lake in Connecticut. The results indicate that valuation is quite sensitive to model specification and that omitting either the waterview or waterfront variables from the hedonic function likely results in a misspecified model. The findings from this study are important for researchers and public agencies charged with managing water resources to bear in mind as the external benefits from existing or proposed man‐made lakes and reservoirs are estimated. Therefore, while it requires considerably more effort to determine which properties are in waterfront locations and which properties have a view, the potential mispecification of “distance‐only” models likely justifies these extra research costs. Further, the findings in this analysis call into question results from distance‐only models in the literature.
abstract_zh: 特征价格文献已经确立，公共水体提供了外部效益，这些效益体现在附近住宅地产的价值之中。文献采用了若干方法来量化这些非市场服务。本文利用一个住宅特征价格模型，检验了模型设定是否会影响资源估值，所使用的案例包括印第安纳州一座积极管理的水库和康涅狄格州一座被动管理的湖泊。结果表明，估值对模型设定十分敏感，而且，若在特征价格函数中遗漏水景视野变量或滨水位置变量，都可能导致模型设定错误。对于研究人员以及负责管理水资源的公共机构而言，在估算现有或拟建人工湖泊和水库的外部效益时，本研究的结论都十分重要。因此，尽管需要花费相当多的精力来确定哪些房产位于滨水位置、哪些房产拥有景观视野，但“纯距离”模型可能存在的设定错误，很可能证明这些额外的研究成本是值得的。此外，本分析的结果对文献中纯距离模型的结论提出了质疑。

title: Sinusoidal modeling applied to spatially variant tropospheric ozone air pollution
abstract: This paper demonstrates how parsimonious models of sinusoidal functions can be used to fit spatially variant time series in which there is considerable variation of a periodic type. A typical shortcoming of such tools relates to the difficulty in capturing idiosyncratic variation in periodic models. The strategy developed here addresses this deficiency. While previous work has sought to overcome the shortcoming by augmenting sinusoids with other techniques, the present approach employs station‐specific sinusoids to supplement a common regional component, which succeeds in capturing local idiosyncratic behavior in a parsimonious manner. The experiments conducted herein reveal that a semi‐parametric approach enables such models to fit spatially varying time series with periodic behavior in a remarkably tight fashion. The methods are applied to a panel data set consisting of hourly air pollution measurements. The augmented sinusoidal models produce an excellent fit to these data at three different levels of spatial detail. Copyright © 2007 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何利用简约的正弦函数模型，来拟合存在显著周期性变化的空间变异时间序列。此类工具的一个典型缺陷在于，难以在周期性模型中捕捉特异性的变动。本文提出的策略弥补了这一不足。以往的研究试图通过用其他技术增强正弦模型来克服该缺陷，而本文的方法则采用站点特定的正弦函数来补充共同的区域成分，从而以简约的方式成功捕捉了局部的特异性行为。本文所做的实验表明，半参数方法使这类模型能够以相当紧密的方式拟合具有周期性行为的空间变化时间序列。这些方法应用于一个由逐时空气污染测量数据构成的面板数据集。增广正弦模型在三种不同的空间细节层次上，都对这些数据产生了出色的拟合。版权所有 © 2007 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

title: Measuring the damages of air pollution in the United States
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Integrated Assessment of the Spatial Variability of Ozone Impacts from Emissions of Nitrogen Oxides
abstract: This paper examines the ozone (O3) damages caused by nitrogen oxides (NO(x)) emissions in different locations around the Atlanta metropolitan area during a summer month. We calculate O3 impacts using a new integrated assessment model that links pollution emissions to their chemical transformation, transport, population exposures, and effects on human health. We find that increased NO(x) emissions in rural areas around Atlanta increase human exposure to ambient O3 twice as much as suburban emissions. However, increased NO(x) emissions in central city Atlanta actually reduce O3 exposures. For downtown emissions, the reduction in human exposures to O3 from titration by NO in the central city outweighs the effects from increased downwind O3. The results indicate that the marginal damage from NO(x) emissions varies greatly across a metropolitan area. The results raise concerns if cap and trade regulations cause emissions to migrate toward higher marginal damage locations.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了夏季某月亚特兰大大都市区周边不同地点的氮氧化物（NO(x)）排放所造成的臭氧（O3）损害。我们使用一种新的综合评估模型计算臭氧影响，该模型将污染排放与其化学转化、传输、人口暴露以及对人体健康的影响联系起来。我们发现，亚特兰大周边农村地区NO(x)排放的增加，使人类暴露于环境臭氧的程度增加的幅度是郊区排放的两倍。然而，亚特兰大市中心的NO(x)排放增加，实际上会降低臭氧暴露。对于市区排放，由市中心NO滴定作用所导致的人类臭氧暴露减少，超过了下风向臭氧增加所带来的影响。结果表明，NO(x)排放的边际损害在整个大都市区内差异很大。如果总量控制与交易监管导致排放向边际损害更高的地区转移，这一结果便令人担忧。
